sessions.title: 'Cris Tales' Postmortem: Innovation, Global Expectations, and Global Disasters

sessions.title: 'Dead Space': Harnessing the Power of Light and Darkness

summary.zh: 《死亡空间》光照团队介绍如何利用明暗关系，塑造重制版的视觉方向。

sessions.title: 'Expeditions: Rome' vs. History

sessions.title: 'Farming Simulator' Postmortem

sessions.title: 'God of War Ragnarok': Building the UI for a AAA Sequel
sessions.title_zh: 《战神：诸神黄昏》：为 AAA 续作构建用户界面

summary.en: Examines how critiques of the previous game's UI informed the sequel, alongside team structure, cross-disciplinary challenges, and technical production advice.
summary.zh: 以对前作界面的内部复盘为起点，介绍续作的界面设计基础、团队组织方式，以及美术、设计与工程协作中的技术注意事项。

sessions.title: 'God of War Ragnarok': Designing AAA Low Vision Game Accessibility
sessions.title_zh: 《战神：诸神黄昏》：设计 AAA 游戏的低视力无障碍功能

summary.en: Traces the design of low-vision support for navigation, puzzles, and general gameplay, including scoping decisions and pitfalls in a large production.
summary.zh: 围绕导航、解谜和一般玩法中的低视力障碍，梳理团队持续四年的设计过程，并讨论大型项目如何界定无障碍工作的范围。

sessions.title: 'God of War Ragnarok's' Visual Scripting Solution

summary.en: God of War Ragnarök examines visual-scripting tools for increasingly complex gameplay systems and sequences.
summary.zh: 《战神：诸神黄昏》介绍支持复杂玩法系统与事件序列的可视化脚本工具。

sessions.title: 'Gotham Knights': Using Systemic Audio Tools to Build a Vibrant Gotham City
sessions.title_zh: 《哥谭骑士》：用系统化音频工具构建鲜活的哥谭市

summary.en: Breaks down the game's audio pipeline through spatial sound, dynamic environmental reflections, and modular ambience systems, with examples of their combined operation.
summary.zh: 通过空间音频、动态环境反射和模块化氛围声系统，拆解哥谭市的音频流程，并结合游戏片段说明各系统如何共同运作。

sessions.title: 'LEVEL UP YOUR GAME': Access 200M Gamers with Razer Chroma RGB and Interhaptics Software (Presented by Razer)

summary.en: Razer demonstrates integrating ambient RGB lighting and high-definition haptics into games.
summary.zh: Razer 演示如何将环境 RGB 灯光与高清触觉反馈接入游戏。

sessions.title: 'Moss: Book II': Toward Powerful and Authentic Voice Performance

summary.en: Moss: Book II examines collaboration between performers, directors, and developers when creating voice performances.

sessions.title: 'Need for Speed': Hyperreal Sound Design

summary.en: Need for Speed Unbound discusses the audio vision and pillars behind its stylized sound design.
summary.zh: 《极品飞车：不羁》介绍风格化声音设计背后的音频目标与支柱。

sessions.title: 'Outcast 2': Developing the Audio of the Future
sessions.title_zh: 《Outcast 2》：开发面向未来的音频

summary.en: Explores technical sound and music design challenges, focusing on nonlinear treatment of cinematic content and creative coordination across a distributed audio team.
summary.zh: 围绕技术音效与音乐设计的挑战，重点讨论如何处理非线性过场内容，以及如何让分布式音频团队深入参与技术和创意工作。

sessions.title: 'Overcrowded: Tycoon' Postmortem: A Tycoon with Emotions
sessions.title_zh: 《Overcrowded: Tycoon》复盘：有情绪的经营游戏

summary.en: Uses Overcrowded: Tycoon to examine Zeptolab's creative process, moving from distinctive concepts and validated prototypes toward a sustained commercial game.
summary.zh: 以《Overcrowded: Tycoon》为例，介绍 Zeptolab 如何系统地产生创意、验证原型，并把这些探索发展为可持续运营的商业游戏。

sessions.title: 'Stray Gods': The Challenges of Creating an Interactive Musical
sessions.title_zh: 《Stray Gods》：制作互动音乐剧的挑战

summary.en: Follows the development of interactive song mechanics and the extended writing, testing, casting, and direction process behind a musical roleplaying game.
summary.zh: 从互动歌曲机制的探索出发，介绍这款音乐剧角色扮演游戏在歌曲创作、测试、选角和演出指导方面的制作过程。

sessions.title: 'The Looker': The Art of Parody Against the Menace of Goofiness
sessions.title_zh: 《The Looker》：对抗胡闹的戏仿艺术

summary.en: Explores gameplay-based parody, close engagement with source material, and the internal consistency needed to keep jokes from undermining core design.
summary.zh: 讨论如何通过玩法而非表面笑料完成戏仿，并结合《The Looker》说明深入理解原作、维持内部一致性与保护核心设计的关系。

sessions.title: 'The Sims': Process and Learnings for Developing DEI Content
sessions.title_zh: 《模拟人生》：开发多元、平等与包容内容的流程和经验

summary.en: Uses The Sims 4 examples, including pronouns, to discuss incorporating community perspectives and studio values into inclusive content development.
summary.zh: 结合《模拟人生4》的代词功能等案例，讨论如何听取玩家、代表性不足群体和资源小组的意见，并将包容理念落实到内容开发中。

sessions.title: 'TUNIC': This Was Here the Whole Time
sessions.title_zh: 《TUNIC》：原来它一直就在这里

summary.en: Presents a loose-ends model of secrets, exploring how layered discoveries and unresolved mysteries shape the feeling of an expansive hidden world.
summary.zh: 把秘密视为尚未收束的线索，结合开发案例讨论如何让发现引出更多疑问，以及悬而未决的谜团为何也能带来探索乐趣。

sessions.title: 'Unpacking' Zen: Designing a Game Without Fail States or Scores
sessions.title_zh: 《Unpacking》的禅意：设计没有失败状态与分数的游戏

summary.en: Explains the rationale and implementation behind a moving-house game that builds its experience without scores, time pressure, dialogue, or conventional failure.
summary.zh: 讨论《Unpacking》为何省去分数、时限、对话和失败状态，以及这些设计选择如何落实到以搬家整理为主题的实际玩法中。

sessions.title: 'Us vs. Them' and the LaserDisc Debacle of 1984
sessions.title_zh: 《Us vs. Them》与 1984 年激光影碟游戏风波

summary.zh: 回顾《Us vs. Them》的制作，并结合其临近上市时的行业变化，分析激光影碟街机从受到追捧到遭遇市场崩塌的背景。

sessions.title: 'Wordle': One Year Later

summary.en: Wordle's producer reflects on the game's development after its acquisition and continued growth.
summary.zh: 《Wordle》制作人回顾游戏被收购之后的发展与持续增长。

sessions.title: 'Wordscapes': How Design and Analytics Keep a Blockbuster Game Growing
sessions.title_zh: 《Wordscapes》：设计与分析如何支持长期增长

summary.en: Examines collaboration between design and analytics through Wordscapes Wildlife and Lost Treasure, connecting feature decisions with live-operation evaluation.
summary.zh: 以 Wildlife 和 Lost Treasure 功能为例，介绍《Wordscapes》的设计与分析团队如何协作，并将新内容设计与运营评估连接起来。

sessions.title: 10 Key Quest Design Lessons from 'The Witcher 3' and 'Cyberpunk 2077'

sessions.title: 10 Live-Service Lessons: Launch Day Is Only the Beginning
sessions.title_zh: 持续运营游戏的十条经验：上线只是起点

summary.en: Draws on Dauntless patch history to discuss the product and development lessons involved in maintaining a live-service game beyond launch.
summary.zh: 结合《Dauntless》长期更新的实际案例，梳理上线之后持续经营游戏的产品与开发经验，讨论如何面对玩家关注和运营需求的变化。

sessions.title: 100-Million Holobux: Transitioning 'Knockout City' to Free-to-Play
sessions.title_zh: 一亿 Holobux：将《Knockout City》转为免费游戏

summary.en: Reviews the transition from a premium console game to free-to-play, emphasizing how plans accounted for the existing player community.
summary.zh: 回顾《Knockout City》从付费主机游戏转向免费模式的设计过程，重点说明团队如何在规划转换时考虑已有玩家。

sessions.title: 200-Million Players Can't Be Wrong: Lessons Learned From 10 Years of 'Beach Buggy Racing'
sessions.title_zh: 两亿玩家的选择：《Beach Buggy Racing》十年经验

summary.en: Reviews a small studio's decade of development, self-publishing, and promotion across the Beach Buggy series and multiple platforms.
summary.zh: 以《Beach Buggy》系列为例，回顾小型独立团队十年间在多平台开发、自行发行和推广中积累的经验与失误。

sessions.title: 29th Annual IASIG Town Hall

summary.en: Audio practitioners discuss improving workflows and professional tools at the annual IASIG gathering.
summary.zh: 音频从业者在年度 IASIG 交流中，讨论工作流程与专业工具改进。

sessions.title: A Complex and Fantastic Battlefield: The 'Conqueror's Blade' Map System
sessions.title_zh: 复杂而精彩的战场：《战意》的地图系统

summary.en: Examines how the tactical game's map presents and filters layered information while managing cognitive load and conveying battlefield atmosphere.
summary.zh: 介绍《战意》的地图如何组织和筛选多层信息，在呈现城池、资源等复杂内容时兼顾玩家认知负担与战场氛围。

summary.zh: 讨论互动剧作如何在宏观上组织有意义的故事树，又在具体分支中保持人物、情感和主题的连贯性。

sessions.title: A New Era of Stereo 3D Gaming: Why and How (presented by Acer)

sessions.title: A Practical Design Playbook for Digital Thriving in Games

sessions.title: AAA Vehicle Audio

sessions.title: Achieving High-Quality 90fps Realism in a Mobile Game, Technically and Visually

summary.zh: 《ACE Racer》分享实现写实移动画面与每秒九十帧目标的技术、美术工作。

sessions.title: Achieving Real-Time Ray Tracing on Xbox with Unity and DirectX 12 (Presented by Microsoft)

sessions.title: Adobe Developer Summit: Advances in Uniform Creation for EA Sports' NHL (Presented by Adobe)

sessions.title: Adobe Developer Summit: The Material Art of 'The Last of Us Part I' (Presented by Adobe)

sessions.title: Advanced Graphics Summit: 'Marvel's Spider-Man' Remastered: A PC Postmortem

sessions.title: Advocacy Microtalks: Cultivate Your Karass

sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：制作《脑航员2》的精彩首领战

summary.en: Explains a modular, data-driven Unreal pipeline for building narrative boss encounters and enabling broader team participation in rapid iteration.
summary.zh: 介绍用于叙事首领战的模块化、数据驱动虚幻引擎流程，讨论如何让更多团队成员参与并快速迭代战斗。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Developing Adventure Game with Free Text Input using NLP
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：利用自然语言处理开发自由文本输入冒险游戏

summary.en: Uses a Portopia revival to discuss modern NLP for adventure games that respond flexibly to user-written text instead of fixed command selections.
summary.zh: 以《港口镇连续杀人事件》的新形式为例，讨论现代自然语言处理如何支持冒险游戏理解自由文本输入。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Let Your Agents Plan Together: Multi-Agent Cooperation With GOAP
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：让智能体共同规划——使用 GOAP 实现多智能体合作

summary.en: Describes decentralized cooperation using GOAP and messaging, where agents plan from local knowledge and request help without shared global memory.
summary.zh: 介绍结合 GOAP 与消息系统的分散式合作，让智能体依据自身知识规划并寻求帮助，讨论无需全局共享记忆的协作方式。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Living in Procedural Worlds: Creature Movement and Spawning in 'Nightingale'
tags: University of Alberta, Inflexion Games Inc
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：生活在程序化世界中——《Nightingale》的生物移动与生成

summary.en: Examines pathfinding and wildlife population in changing procedural realms, including terrain preferences, varied creature sizes, and large navigation networks.
summary.zh: 讨论变化中的程序化世界如何支持寻路与野生动物生成，涉及地形偏好、不同体型生物和大规模动态导航网络。

sessions.title: AI Summit: Logic Programming in Commercial Games: Experiences and Lessons Learned
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：商业游戏中的逻辑编程——经验与教训

summary.en: Uses two games to discuss logic programming for social NPC behavior, constraint-based content generation, and build-time asset validation.
summary.zh: 结合两款游戏，介绍逻辑编程在社会规范 NPC 行为、约束式内容生成和构建期资产一致性验证中的应用。

sessions.title: AI Summit: The Dimensional Curse of AAA Game Balancing: Data-Efficient and Robust Reinforcement Learning
sessions.title_zh: AI 峰会：AAA 游戏平衡的维度诅咒——高数据效率且稳健的强化学习

summary.en: Discusses reinforcement-learning approaches to game balancing under limited data, unstable simulators, and rapidly changing mechanics during production.
summary.zh: 讨论强化学习用于游戏平衡时面临的数据需求、模拟器不稳定和机制频繁变化，并介绍团队针对这些限制的处理思路。

sessions.title: All Hands On Deck: Building the Ships of 'Skull and Bones'
sessions.title_zh: 全员上甲板：制作《碧海黑帆》的船只

summary.en: Explores procedural art tools for complex ship structures and customization while balancing gameplay, technical, and ongoing production requirements.
summary.zh: 围绕船只结构与外观定制，介绍程序化美术工具如何服务复杂资产制作，并兼顾玩法、技术限制和持续运营需求。

sessions.title: Alternative Controller Game Design: From Game Design to Controller Design
sessions.title_zh: 另类控制器游戏设计：从游戏设计到控制器设计

summary.en: Examines custom controllers as elements of mechanics, sensory feel, narrative, and play space, rather than treating input hardware as a neutral conduit.
summary.zh: 从机制、感官体验、叙事和游玩空间四个角度，探讨自制控制器如何直接成为游戏设计的一部分。

sessions.title: An 'IMMORTALITY' Project: Creating the Ultimate Interactive Movie

summary.en: Sam Barlow and Half Mermaid discuss conceiving and prototyping IMMORTALITY's interconnected interactive films.
summary.zh: Sam Barlow 与 Half Mermaid 分享《IMMORTALITY》互联互动电影的构思与原型开发。

youtube.title: An 'IMMORTALITY' Project: Creating the Ultimate Interactive Movie

sessions.title: An Innovative UA Model: Live-Streaming Traffic-Buying

summary.en: Fantasy Westward Journey's team discusses livestreaming as an approach to user acquisition.
summary.zh: 《梦幻西游》团队探讨利用直播进行用户获取的方法。

sessions.title: An Uncharted Sea: Developing the Art Direction for 'Skull and Bones'
sessions.title_zh: 驶入未知海域：《碧海黑帆》的美术方向开发

summary.en: Explains how research into historical ship anatomy informed visual direction while being adapted to gameplay and technical constraints.
summary.zh: 介绍团队如何研究历史船只结构，并在玩法和技术需求的约束下调整视觉方向，以呈现海盗题材的幻想。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: 'Gotham Knights': Simultaneous and Immersive Cinematic Storytelling for the Batman Family
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：《哥谭骑士》——蝙蝠家族同步而沉浸的过场叙事

summary.en: Explores cinematic direction and technical processes for four interchangeable protagonists, including the construction of shared scenes with distinct character journeys.
summary.zh: 讨论四位可替换主角带来的过场导演与技术问题，说明团队如何制作共用场景，同时保留各角色的情感历程。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: 'Potionomics' Show and Tell
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：《Potionomics》展示与讲解

summary.en: Connects emotional goals, animation principles, production scope, audience feedback, and character body language in the game's animation process.
summary.zh: 从情绪目标与动画原则出发，讨论制作规模、观众反馈和角色肢体语言如何共同影响《Potionomics》的动画开发。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Animation in 'God of War: Ragnarok'
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：《战神：诸神黄昏》的动画

summary.en: Four short presentations examine cinematic shots, storytelling techniques, dismemberment systems, and direction challenges within the studio's animation work.
summary.zh: 通过四场短讲，从镜头拆解、过场叙事技巧、肢解系统和导演挑战等方面展示工作室的多种动画方法。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Building Kiriko's Ultimate Ability in 'Overwatch 2'
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：制作《守望先锋2》雾子的终极技能

summary.en: Follows the visual development of Kiriko's gate pathway and fox spirit, connecting artistic mockups, performance constraints, and engineering decisions.
summary.zh: 围绕雾子终极技能中的鸟居路径与狐灵，介绍从美术构想到工程实现的过程，并讨论视觉表现与性能之间的协调。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: GDC Animation Microtalks
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：GDC 动画微型演讲

summary.en: Brings together animation practitioners to discuss character performance, technical techniques, production culture, and communication with players across different development contexts.
summary.zh: 汇集不同规模项目的动画从业者，讨论角色表演、技术技巧、动画制作文化，以及动画在向玩家传递信息中的作用。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Making Faces: A Masterclass of Facial Animation
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：制作面孔——面部动画大师课

summary.en: Connects facial observation and anatomy to rigging and animation, showing how muscle behavior and subtle expressions inform digital character performances.
summary.zh: 将面部观察、解剖知识与绑定动画相联系，讨论肌肉互动、细微表情和口型如何转化为数字角色的情感表演。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: Motion Matching at EA: Five Years Later
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：EA 的动作匹配，五年之后

summary.en: Reviews the evolution of motion matching at EA, emphasizing higher-level workflow concepts affecting animators, technical animators, and designers.
summary.zh: 回顾 EA 五年间动作匹配应用的变化，重点讨论影响动画师、技术动画师和设计师的高层流程与工作方式。

sessions.title: Animation Summit: The Tricks of the Trade
sessions.title_zh: 动画峰会：行家技巧

summary.en: Six animators each share three practical insights, ranging from workflow shortcuts and movement observations to approaches that shaped their animation practice.
summary.zh: 六位动画师各自分享三条影响其创作的经验，涵盖操作技巧、人体运动观察，以及处理动画项目的方法。

sessions.title: Applying Blizzard's Core Design Principles to Create Genre-Defining Games
sessions.title_zh: 运用暴雪核心设计原则，打造定义品类的游戏

summary.en: Explores the design principles used across Blizzard's franchises and presents them as a framework for teams approaching games in different genres.
summary.zh: 结合暴雪多个系列的设计实践，介绍其长期使用的核心原则，并讨论团队如何借助这一框架思考不同品类的游戏。

sessions.title: Architecture Deep Dive for a No-coding Gaming Platform(Yahaha) and its Application for Education: From 'Assembler' to 'Scripts' (Presented by YAHAHA Studios)

summary.en: Yahaha discusses its no-code platform architecture and applications in game-development education.
summary.zh: Yahaha 介绍无代码平台架构，以及在游戏开发教育中的应用。

sessions.title: Around the Ecosystem with Polygon Labs (Presented by Polygon Labs)

summary.en: Polygon Labs surveys routes into the blockchain-gaming ecosystem for games and players.
summary.zh: Polygon Labs 概述游戏与玩家参与区块链游戏生态的不同路径。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Artist vs. Manager
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：美术师与管理者

summary.en: Draws on environment-art leadership in major CDPR games to discuss management tradeoffs and ways to maintain creative practice while leading a team.
summary.zh: 结合 CDPR 大型项目的环境美术带队经验，讨论管理工作的利弊，以及负责人如何在团队职责之外保持创作参与。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Big Visuals, Small Budget: Get the Most from a Lean Art Team
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：大视觉，小预算——充分发挥精简团队的能力

summary.en: Explains how to prioritize visual problems, establish usable targets, and organize a small art team around a distinctive, achievable game look.
summary.zh: 讨论如何排序视觉设计问题、建立可执行的美术目标，并组织小团队在预算限制下形成鲜明且可实现的游戏外观。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Building a Visual Identity: An Art Direction Framework
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：构建视觉身份的框架

summary.en: Presents an art-direction framework linking artistic, technical, creative, and marketing considerations to visual pillars and a coherent game identity.
summary.zh: 提出结合艺术、技术、创意与营销考虑的美术指导框架，讨论如何确立视觉支柱并形成一致的游戏身份。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: Finding Your Game's Art Style On The Cheap
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：低成本寻找游戏美术风格

summary.en: Outlines an affordable discovery process using visual research, inspiration boards, AI imagery, and competitor analysis to guide concept art and positioning.
summary.zh: 介绍通过视觉研究、灵感板、AI 图像和竞品分析探索美术方向的方法，讨论如何据此聚焦游戏特点并开展概念设计。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: The Art of 'Arcane'
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：《英雄联盟：双城之战》的艺术

summary.en: Revisits the creative journey and collective production work involved in adapting the League of Legends universe into Arcane's animated world.
summary.zh: 回顾《双城之战》的创作历程，介绍团队如何共同把《英雄联盟》的世界转化为动画作品。

sessions.title: Art Direction Summit: The Art of Making Vistas
sessions.title_zh: 美术指导峰会：远景制作的艺术

summary.en: Uses God of War Ragnarok environments to trace vista production from composition and asset creation to finishing and large-scale optimization.
summary.zh: 结合《战神：诸神黄昏》的环境案例，梳理远景从构图、资产制作到成品打磨的流程，并讨论大尺度场景的美术与优化问题。

sessions.title: Art of 'The Last Clockwinder': Visual Cohesion
sessions.title_zh: 《The Last Clockwinder》的艺术：视觉统一性

summary.en: Follows a small team's VR art direction from concepts to finished assets, connecting mechanics and narrative within mobile hardware constraints.
summary.zh: 介绍小团队从概念探索到最终资产的美术指导过程，讨论如何在移动 VR 硬件限制下，让视觉、机制和叙事形成统一感。

sessions.title: Art of 'Thirsty Suitors'
sessions.title_zh: 《Thirsty Suitors》的艺术

summary.en: Explores how a remote indie art team combined 2D and 3D techniques, cultural perspectives, and scalable workflows to establish an illustrative visual style.
summary.zh: 讨论远程独立美术团队如何结合二维与三维技法、文化经验和可扩展流程，为游戏建立插画化的视觉风格。

sessions.title: Art Optimization in the 41st Millennium: How FatShark Constructed their Central Asset Pipeline with Simplygon (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 第 41 千年的美术优化：FatShark 如何用 Simplygon 构建中央资产流程（微软呈现）

summary.en: Uses Darktide assets to examine optimization challenges from characters to entire levels and the Simplygon tools integrated into FatShark's pipeline.
summary.zh: 以《Darktide》的角色和关卡资产为例，讨论美术优化的具体难题，以及 FatShark 如何将 Simplygon 工具纳入资产流程。

sessions.title: Assessment Games
sessions.title_zh: 评估型游戏

summary.en: Examines the design of cognitive-skill assessment games, where engaging play must generate meaningful telemetry under constraints different from entertainment products.
summary.zh: 介绍认知能力评估游戏的设计问题，讨论如何在保留参与感的同时产生有意义的行为数据，以及这类产品与娱乐游戏不同的约束。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: An Important Conversation About Conversations
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：关于对话的重要对话

summary.en: Breaks down Wayward Strand's large dialogue production through team coordination, planning, recording, post-production, and implementation across multiple studios.
summary.zh: 从团队协作、规划、录音、后期与实装等环节，拆解《Wayward Strand》跨工作室完成大量互动对白的制作方式。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Building Audio Careers, Together
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：共同建设音频职业生涯

summary.en: Explores collaborative relationships in game audio and their informal, community, and commercial roles for employees, freelancers, and newcomers.
summary.zh: 讨论游戏音频中的合作关系，介绍它们在日常交流、社群与商业工作中对雇员、自由职业者和新人的作用。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Embracing Audio Technology for Enhanced Creativity
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：拥抱音频技术，拓展创意

summary.en: Uses research and Redout 2 examples to discuss experimentation, originality, instinct, and judgment when balancing tools with an individual sound-design voice.
summary.zh: 结合研究与《Redout 2》经验，讨论实验、原创性、直觉和判断，思考声音设计如何在工具应用中保留个人表达。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Sounds as Intended: Quality Assurance in Game Audio
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：听见设计本意——游戏音频质量保证

summary.en: Explains audio-QA collaboration through testing responsibilities, information needs, and support practices that help teams evaluate the intended listening experience.
summary.zh: 介绍音频团队与质量保证人员的合作方式，涵盖测试职责、所需信息及支持流程，讨论如何共同检查听觉体验。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: Spatial Audio: From Screen-Based to World-Based with AR and VR

summary.en: Spatial-audio practitioners discuss moving from screen-oriented experiences to world-based AR and VR sound.
summary.zh: 空间音频从业者讨论从屏幕体验转向基于世界空间的 AR、VR 声音设计。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: The Art of the Theme
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：主题音乐的艺术

summary.en: Uses Riot Games projects to examine theme composition, connecting melody, structure, instrumentation, musical sound design, and advanced production choices.
summary.zh: 结合《英雄联盟》等项目，讨论主题音乐从旋律、结构和配器，到音乐音色设计与制作技术的创作过程。

sessions.title: Audio Summit: The Value of Play in Interactive Audio
sessions.title_zh: 音频峰会：玩心在互动音频中的价值

summary.en: Explores playful experimentation with unconventional instruments, controllers, and engines as a way to develop audio ideas, workflows, and tool familiarity.
summary.zh: 通过非传统乐器、控制器和引擎实验，讨论如何把玩心融入日常音频工作，用探索来发展创意、工作流程与工具理解。

sessions.title: Autodesk Developer Summit: Creating a Digital Identity (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: Autodesk 开发者峰会：创建数字身份（Autodesk 呈现）

summary.en: Follows the creation of a digital model and clothing with 3ds Max and Substance, connecting high-end production techniques to an AR experience.
summary.zh: 介绍数字人物及其服装的制作过程，说明如何运用 3ds Max、Substance 和高规格制作流程开发 AR 体验。

sessions.title: Autodesk Developer Summit: Luminous Productions: The Making of 'Forspoken' Cutscenes (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: Autodesk 开发者峰会：Luminous Productions《魔咒之地》过场制作（Autodesk 呈现）

summary.en: Examines Forspoken's cutscene workflow from assets and performance capture to character animation and layout using Maya, MotionBuilder, and ShotGrid.
summary.zh: 梳理《魔咒之地》从资产、表演捕捉到角色动画和场景布局的过场流程，介绍 Maya、MotionBuilder 与 ShotGrid 的应用。

sessions.title: Autodesk Developer Summit: Maya Codex: Leveraging Large Language Models for Intuitive Interactions (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: Autodesk 开发者峰会：Maya Codex——用大语言模型实现直观交互（Autodesk 呈现）

summary.en: Presents Autodesk and Microsoft's exploration of natural-language interaction in Maya through large language models and connected content-creation tools.
summary.zh: 介绍 Autodesk 与微软将大语言模型连接到 Maya 的探索，讨论艺术家通过自然语言与内容制作工具交互的方式。

sessions.title: Autodesk Developer Summit: New Tales from the Borderlands: Maximizing Time with an Automated Cinematic Pipeline (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: Autodesk 开发者峰会：《新无主之地传说》——以自动过场流程节约时间（Autodesk 呈现）

summary.en: Explains how Gearbox Quebec automated animation-file creation and data management with Maya and ShotGrid for a demanding cinematic production schedule.
summary.zh: 介绍 Gearbox 魁北克团队如何用 Maya 和 ShotGrid 自动创建文件、管理动画数据，以应对紧凑的过场内容制作安排。

sessions.title: Autodesk Developer Summit: Next-Gen Game Workflows with USD ft. Epic Games Panel (Presented by Autodesk)
sessions.title_zh: Autodesk 开发者峰会：与 Epic Games 讨论 USD 次世代游戏流程（Autodesk 呈现）

summary.en: A panel examines game asset pipeline challenges and considers how USD practices from film and television might inform an extensible production approach.
summary.zh: 围绕游戏资产流程的难题，讨论影视领域的 USD 实践能带来哪些启发，以及开放、可扩展方案在游戏制作中的可能用途。

sessions.title: Being a Unicorn: Multiclassing in an Industry That Wants Specialization

summary.en: Multidisciplinary developers discuss navigating a games industry whose hiring often emphasizes specialization.
summary.zh: 跨专业开发者讨论如何在招聘偏重单一专长的游戏行业中发展。

sessions.title: Black Excellence in Game Development: The Designer's Dilemma
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发中的黑人卓越人才：设计师的困境

summary.en: Discusses how workplace structures and creative dynamics can better support Black designers and provide room for diverse design ideas.
summary.zh: 讨论企业如何在组织环境与创意协作中更好地支持黑人设计师，并为不同经验所形成的设计想法提供发展空间。

sessions.title: Breaking Barriers: Combat Accessibility in 'God of War Ragnarok'
sessions.title_zh: 打破障碍：《战神：诸神黄昏》的战斗无障碍

summary.en: Explores combat-accessibility design through unintended barriers, concrete fixes, and conflicts between inclusive interaction and established design intentions.
summary.zh: 结合具体障碍与处理案例，讨论战斗无障碍如何挑战既有设计直觉，以及包容性操作与原本设计意图之间的协调。

sessions.title: Breaking Down Barriers: How Great Mentors Become Even Greater Leaders

summary.en: A leadership session examines how mentoring can strengthen the mentors' own leadership practice.
summary.zh: 领导力分享讨论导师工作如何反过来提升指导者自身的领导实践。

sessions.title: Breathing Life Into 'The Last of Us': Part I and II
sessions.title_zh: 为《最后生还者》第一部与第二部注入呼吸

summary.en: Explains the breathing system's conception, prototypes, collaboration, and implementation as audio responses to a protagonist's physical and emotional state.
summary.zh: 介绍呼吸系统从概念、原型到协作实装的过程，讨论如何通过声音表现主角在行动中的身体状态和情绪变化。

sessions.title: BroadLeaf: Real-Time Cinematic Rendering of Large-Scale Forests
sessions.title_zh: BroadLeaf：大规模森林的实时电影级渲染

summary.en: Describes hierarchical leaf geometry and automatic LOD handling for large forests, including smooth transitions, selection, culling, and individual-leaf interaction.
summary.zh: 介绍通过叶片几何层级和自动 LOD 管理渲染大规模森林的方法，涉及平滑过渡、选择剔除与单叶交互。

sessions.title: Build the Next Generation of VR and MR Experiences with Meta Presence Platform (Presented by Meta)

summary.en: Meta introduces Presence Platform technologies for experiences blending physical and virtual environments.
summary.zh: Meta 介绍用于融合现实与虚拟环境体验的 Presence Platform 技术。

sessions.title: Building a Next Gen World with a Small Environment Team
sessions.title_zh: 小型环境团队如何构建次世代世界

summary.en: Reviews The Callisto Protocol's environment production choices, including modularity, materials, scan data, and marketplace resources under tight staffing and deadlines.
summary.zh: 回顾《木卫四协议》环境团队在人员与工期限制下的制作取舍，重点讨论模块化、材质、扫描数据和市场资源的使用。

sessions.title: Building a Well-Rounded Party Fireside Chat: Wizards' Everyday Commitment to Representation in Games

summary.en: Wizards of the Coast discusses representation through a conversation about its everyday game-making commitments.

sessions.title: Building Champions: Character Art Pipeline for 'Rumbleverse'

summary.en: Explores accessory modeling, texturing, and system design for six contrasting body types while preserving visual appeal and consistent customization combinations.
summary.zh: 围绕六类差异明显的体型，介绍配件建模、贴图和定制系统如何处理形变，并保持角色外观与组合的协调。

sessions.title: Building Night City: The Technology of 'Cyberpunk 2077'
sessions.title_zh: 构建夜之城：《赛博朋克2077》的技术

summary.en: Examines REDengine 4 decisions around prefab world structure, system streaming, memory, and CPU performance, including rationale and retrospective lessons.
summary.zh: 介绍 REDengine 4 在预制件世界结构、系统流送、内存与 CPU 性能方面的决策，并讨论这些选择背后的原因与反思。

sessions.title: Building Sustainable Game Economies: The Three Design Pillars (Presented by Machinations.io)
sessions.title_zh: 构建可持续游戏经济：三大设计支柱（Machinations.io 呈现）

summary.en: Introduces economic design fundamentals through currencies, inflation, resource allocation, trading, and pricing, with attention to data and ongoing iteration.
summary.zh: 围绕货币、通胀、资源分配、交易和定价介绍游戏经济设计基础，并讨论数据分析与持续测试如何参与运营中的调整。

sessions.title: Cards, Dice, and RNGs: Using Randomness Intentionally
sessions.title_zh: 卡牌、骰子与随机数：有意识地使用随机性

summary.en: Builds a practical framework for choosing randomization mechanics, diagnosing probability problems, and giving players ways to manage uncertainty.
summary.zh: 建立选择随机机制的实用框架，讨论如何识别概率问题，并让玩家拥有应对和管理不确定性的手段。

sessions.title: Career Progression and Value: Set Your Teams Up for Success
sessions.title_zh: 职业成长与价值：为团队创造成功条件

summary.en: Explains a people-focused career-development process using goal setting and transparent expectations to help team members understand progression and feel valued.
summary.zh: 介绍以人为中心的职业发展流程，通过目标设置和透明预期，帮助团队成员理解成长路径并感受到自身价值。

sessions.title: Caring for Togetherness: Nurturing Hybridity in the Cross-Platform Game Community
sessions.title_zh: 关照共同体：培育跨平台游戏社区的混合性

summary.en: Uses Discord research to discuss communities spanning platforms, cultures, languages, and online-offline boundaries, with management and tool-design guidance.
summary.zh: 结合 Discord 社群研究，讨论跨平台、文化、语言及线上线下边界的混合社区，并提出管理与工具设计思路。

sessions.title: Case Study: Creating Realistic Facial Motion for 'The Quarry'
sessions.title_zh: 案例研究：为《采石场惊魂》创建写实面部动作

summary.en: Explores Digital Domain's facial-capture pipeline and its adaptation of film-oriented performance transfer to game-scale workloads and interactive characters.
summary.zh: 介绍 Digital Domain 的面部捕捉流程，讨论如何把面向电影的表演转移技术调整为适合游戏规模与互动角色的方案。

sessions.title: Chaos Theory in Game Music
sessions.title_zh: 游戏音乐中的混沌理论

summary.en: Analyzes Jurassic World Primal Ops music through tonal ambiguity, polytonality, tonic shifts, and unconventional harmony, supported by audiovisual examples.
summary.zh: 通过《Jurassic World Primal Ops》的音乐实例，分析调性模糊、多调性、主音转移及非常规和声在营造不安与意外感中的用法。

sessions.title: Climate Crisis Workshop: Use Your Game Developer Superpowers to Fight The Climate Crisis

summary.en: An interactive workshop explores integrating climate concerns into game-development work.
summary.zh: 互动工作坊探讨将气候议题纳入游戏开发工作的方法。

sessions.title: Climate Games: The Developer's Field Guide
sessions.title_zh: 气候游戏：开发者野外指南

summary.en: Introduces a structured creative process for climate-related game initiatives, drawing on Ubisoft's work helping teams connect environmental goals with their audiences.
summary.zh: 结合育碧支持开发团队的实践，介绍气候主题游戏的结构化创作方法，讨论如何把环保目标与受众能够接受的体验连接起来。

sessions.title: Closing the Gap: Chasing Effective Level Design Processes in 'Rollerdrome'
sessions.title_zh: 弥合差距：探索《Rollerdrome》的有效关卡设计流程

summary.en: Uses level postmortems to examine the challenges of combining skating and shooting and how lessons fed into later levels and a remote team's process.
summary.zh: 通过多个关卡复盘，讨论滑行与射击结合所产生的设计问题，以及团队如何把解决经验应用到后续关卡和远程开发流程。

sessions.title: Co-creating Games on Mobile (Yahaha): A Generic Architecture for Runtime Game Editor (Presented by YAHAHA Studios)
sessions.title_zh: 移动端共同创作游戏：Yahaha 运行时编辑器的通用架构（YAHAHA Studios 呈现）

summary.en: Introduces collaborative, no-code game creation across mobile and PC, including editable assets, composable logic, and switching between building and play.
summary.zh: 介绍移动端与 PC 上的无代码协作创作，涵盖资产属性编辑、逻辑组件组合，以及共同搭建和试玩之间的切换。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: 'Subway Surfers': Give Your Players a Voice, They'll Give You a Game
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：《地铁跑酷》——让玩家发声，他们会回馈一款游戏

summary.en: Examines SYBO's social communication and audience-feedback practices for Subway Surfers, including adapting content and relationships to changing platform rhythms.
summary.zh: 介绍 SYBO 为《地铁跑酷》开展社交沟通与反馈处理的方式，讨论如何随着平台节奏调整内容和玩家关系。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: A Discourse on Discourse: Understanding Fandom and Online Communities
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：讨论中的讨论——理解粉丝文化与线上社区

summary.en: Uses Blaseball community experience to examine fandom behavior, toxicity, marginalization, and the challenges of designing healthy communities that can grow.
summary.zh: 结合《Blaseball》社区经历，分析粉丝文化、不良行为与边缘化问题，讨论健康社区随规模增长面临的挑战。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Community Sentiment Reports: Quantifying Feelings
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：社区情绪报告——量化感受

summary.en: Explains what regular community-sentiment reports should contain and how quantified observations can inform development and community decisions.
summary.zh: 介绍定期社区情绪报告应包含的内容，并讨论量化观察如何为开发团队和社区运营提供决策依据。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: How a Three-Eyed Horse Changed Meme Marketing Forever
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：一匹三眼马如何改变表情梗营销

summary.en: Discusses incorporating memes into brand marketing and adapting community-facing campaigns to a studio's resources and scale.
summary.zh: 讨论如何把网络梗融入品牌与社区营销，并根据工作室的规模和资源选择合适的表达与推广方式。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: How to Use Niche Audiences to Create Brand Evangelists
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：如何让小众受众成为品牌传播者

summary.en: Draws on specialist-game communities to discuss how unmet interests and demands for authenticity can become strong, sustained support for a brand.
summary.zh: 结合专业题材游戏社群经验，讨论如何理解小众玩家对真实与准确的要求，并将这些兴趣转化为持续的品牌支持。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Negative Reviews Begin With a Forum Post
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：差评始于论坛帖子

summary.en: Examines connections between support requests, social sentiment, and negative Steam reviews, discussing monitoring and timely responses to player frustration.
summary.zh: 讨论求助帖、社交情绪与 Steam 差评之间的联系，介绍如何监测玩家遇到的问题并及时回应不满。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Play With Your Audience: Enhancing Your Social Strategy Through Theater
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：与受众一起玩——用戏剧技巧增强社交策略

summary.en: Applies performance techniques to brand voice and social communication, exploring playful ways for community managers to connect with their audiences.
summary.zh: 把表演技巧应用于品牌口吻和社交沟通，讨论社区管理者如何以更有玩心的方式创作内容并连接受众。

sessions.title: Community Management Summit: Surviving 'Vampire Survivors': Agile Community Management
sessions.title_zh: 社区管理峰会：应对《吸血鬼幸存者》热潮——敏捷社区管理

summary.en: Reviews adapting to a rapidly growing indie community, including personal tone, audience relationships, failed experiments, and prioritizing limited management time.
summary.zh: 回顾应对快速增长独立游戏社区的过程，讨论个人化语气、玩家关系、未达预期的尝试，以及有限时间的优先安排。

sessions.title: Companion Traversal in 'God of War Ragnarok'
sessions.title_zh: 《战神：诸神黄昏》的同伴移动

summary.en: Explains character-specific navigation, AI components, level-design setup, and animation techniques for companions traversing independently alongside the player.
summary.zh: 介绍同伴独立移动所需的角色导航、AI 组件、关卡配置和动画技术，讨论多个角色如何在同一套系统中完成穿行。

sessions.title: Connect Players Across Platforms and Storefronts with Epic Online Services (Presented by Epic Games)

summary.en: Introduces EOS crossplay integration and setup, with Midnight Ghost Hunt examples illustrating how a game connects players across platforms and storefronts.
summary.zh: 介绍 EOS 跨平台联机的接入与配置，并以《Midnight Ghost Hunt》为例说明如何连接来自不同平台和商店的玩家。

sessions.title: Constrain Your Content: Generating Better Content with Constraint Programming

sessions.title: Content Creators Are King Too (Presented by Mastercard)

summary.zh: 围绕游戏内容创作者面临的付款效率问题，讨论其他行业的支付方案如何应用到游戏社区与创作者经济中的结算环节。

sessions.title: Create Hyper-realistic Real-Time Characters (Presented by Unity Technologies)

summary.zh: 展示运用 Unity 工具制作互动数字角色的方式，聚焦写实外观与实时动作捕捉的结合。

sessions.title: Creating Context Art in the Open World of 'Saints Row's' Santo Ileso

summary.en: Explains the context-artist role through fictional branding, signs, landmarks, and road markers, tracing how the discipline developed during world production.

sessions.title: Creating Playable Horror in 'The Dark Pictures Anthology'
sessions.title_zh: 在《黑相集》中创造可玩的恐怖

summary.en: Reviews how the series selects and invents mechanics to support cinematic horror, including design decisions, evolution, and retrospective tradeoffs.
summary.zh: 讨论《黑相集》如何为电影式恐怖体验选择或创造机制，并回顾关键决策、系列演变和团队事后反思的设计取舍。

sessions.title: Creating Realistic Landscapes in Unreal Engine with Houdini (Presented by Epic Games)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Houdini 在虚幻引擎中创建写实地形（Epic Games 呈现）

summary.en: Details Embark's landscape workflow from LiDAR processing and Gaea integration to Houdini heightfield tools and Unreal import/export.

sessions.title: Creating the Art of 'Harry Potter: Magic Awakened'
sessions.title_zh: 创作《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》的美术

summary.en: Explains a hand-painted stylized art pipeline spanning concepts, characters, environments, effects, animation, shaders, and a customized rendering approach.
summary.zh: 介绍手绘风格化美术流程，从早期概念设计延伸到角色、场景、特效、动作、着色器和定制渲染方案。

sessions.title: Creating Your First Game in Fortnite (With UEFN) (Presented by Epic Games)
sessions.title_zh: 在《堡垒之夜》中创建你的第一款游戏：使用 UEFN（Epic Games 呈现）

summary.en: Outlines Fortnite's plans and creation tools for expanding player-made games and experiences within its publishing ecosystem.
summary.zh: 介绍《堡垒之夜》扩展玩家创作生态的规划，以及支持用户制作和发布游戏体验的相关技术与工具。

sessions.title: Creative Direction 101: Improve Your Creative Direction and Feedback
sessions.title_zh: 创意指导入门：改善创意方向与反馈

summary.en: Draws on Destiny and Apex Legends leadership to discuss creative-director mindset, team culture, and communicating direction that supports other creators.

sessions.title: Creative Future with Artificial Intelligence
sessions.title_zh: 人工智能与创意的未来

summary.zh: 从美术与游戏开发者的角度审视生成式 AI，讨论技术采用、伦理与法律问题，以及从业者应如何理解其对个人工作的影响。

sessions.title: Cross-Platform Mobile and PC Rendering in 'Earth: Revival'

sessions.title: Cultivating a Positive Work Culture

summary.zh: 本场工作室文化分享讨论支持健康工作环境的实践。

sessions.title: Deep Dive into Data-Oriented Design for a Cross-platform UGC Game Engine (Yahaha): Stateful, Assets, Synchronization, Performance (Presented by YAHAHA Studios)
sessions.title_zh: 跨平台 UGC 游戏引擎 Yahaha 的数据导向设计：状态、资产、同步与性能（YAHAHA Studios 呈现）

sessions.title: Defiant in Life and Death: What Happens After You Fail?

summary.zh: 结合 Defiant Development 关闭的经历，反思公司结构与文化如何影响团队，并讨论面对成功、失败和职业变动时的情绪经验。

sessions.title: Define Your Audience Now, Not Later
sessions.title_zh: 现在就定义受众，而不是以后

summary.en: Introduces audience-definition methods for indie genres, connecting early market understanding with creative direction and practical marketing decisions.
summary.zh: 介绍独立游戏常见品类的受众界定方法，讨论如何在早期理解目标玩家，并将市场认识与创作方向和营销决策联系起来。

sessions.title: Designing 'MARVEL SNAP'

sessions.title: Designing Through Dissonance: Confronting Feedback with an Open Mind
sessions.title_zh: 在不协调中设计：以开放心态面对反馈

summary.en: Examines common traps in receiving design feedback and offers practices for assessing unwelcome criticism through examples from a design director's career.
summary.zh: 结合设计总监的职业案例，分析接收反馈时常见的思维陷阱，并介绍如何理性评估那些不愿听到的意见。

sessions.title: Developing 'Terra Nil': A Strategy Game About Nature, Not Expansion
sessions.title_zh: 开发《Terra Nil》：关于自然而非扩张的策略游戏

summary.en: Explores how inspiration from ecological balance led the team to reconsider resource exploitation and other conventions of strategy-game design.
summary.zh: 讨论团队如何从自然平衡中获得灵感，重新审视策略游戏中资源开发与扩张等惯例，并形成《Terra Nil》的设计方向。

sessions.title: Developing Marvel's 'Iron Man VR' for Meta Quest (Presented by Meta)

sessions.title: Developing the Stylized VFX of 'Need For Speed Unbound'

summary.zh: 介绍风格化驾驶特效的美术探索与技术实现，并讨论如何把它们融入写实竞速玩法，成为反馈和良好驾驶的奖励。

sessions.title: Differentiated Management Communities: Centralized vs. Decentralized Communities
sessions.title_zh: 差异化社区管理：中心化与去中心化社区

summary.zh: 比较松散交流社区与围绕核心人物形成的社区，讨论其细分类型、相应管理方法，以及社区运营中的风险处理。

sessions.title: Discord Apps 101: Come Build! (Presented by Discord)
sessions.title_zh: Discord 应用入门：来动手构建吧！（Discord 呈现）

summary.zh: 通过小游戏、组队工具和排行榜等应用示例，介绍 Discord 平台功能、原型开发入门与应用设计实践。

sessions.title: Discord Developer Platform: Bring Your Ideas to Millions of Fans (Presented by Discord)
sessions.title_zh: Discord 开发者平台：把创意带给众多粉丝（Discord 呈现）

summary.en: Surveys Discord's extensible app platform and the opportunities it offers for custom experiences, community engagement, gameplay connections, and commercial projects.
summary.zh: 概述 Discord 可扩展应用平台，讨论如何利用定制体验连接玩法、社区参与、品牌传播和商业项目。

sessions.title: Diverse Business Models Fueling Growth Across the Games Industry (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 推动游戏行业增长的多元商业模式（微软呈现）

summary.en: Compares experiences with premium sales, free-to-play, and subscriptions, discussing the challenges and audience opportunities associated with each approach.
summary.zh: 结合行业从业者的经验，比较买断、免费游玩和订阅等商业模式，讨论各自面临的挑战与触达玩家的机会。

sessions.title: Educators Summit: Essential Game UX Every Student Should Know

summary.en: An educator surveys game-UX fundamentals that students should understand across development disciplines.

sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：弹幕中的契合——把《Mothergunship》带入 VR

summary.en: Reviews Mothergunship: Forge development, testing assumptions about crafting, technical challenges, schedules, and the transferability of non-VR development experience.
summary.zh: 复盘《Mothergunship: Forge》的制作，审视自由组装、技术难点与工期假设，并讨论传统开发经验在 VR 项目中的适用边界。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Art Direction for VR: Designing for Spatial Perspectives
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：VR 美术指导——为空间视角设计

summary.en: Proposes a spatial art-direction workflow connecting readability and emotion with VR play space, flat-screen marketing, creative culture, and decision criteria.
summary.zh: 提出面向空间体验的美术流程，连接视觉可读性、情感表达、VR 玩家空间、平面宣传素材与团队决策标准。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Building Better Digital Ethics and Laws: Meatspace meets Metaverse

Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society at Harvard University
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：完善数字伦理与法律——现实世界遇上元宇宙

summary.en: Examines tensions between interconnected digital worlds and fragmented laws, terms, privacy policies, and rights frameworks when considering fair and workable virtual spaces.
summary.zh: 讨论互联数字世界与分散法律、服务条款、隐私规则和权利体系之间的矛盾，思考公平且可行的虚拟环境需要怎样的基础。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Building Big Games on Little Headsets
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：在小头显上构建大游戏

summary.en: Explains Owlchemy's SplatTech development for Quest 2, focusing on graphics constraints, implementation challenges, and performance optimization.
summary.zh: 介绍 Owlchemy 为 Quest 2 开发 SplatTech 的过程，重点讨论头显图形限制、实现挑战和性能优化。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Clinical Virtual Reality: A Brief Review of the Future
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：临床虚拟现实——未来的简要回顾

summary.en: Surveys clinical VR through exposure, distraction, motivation, measurement, and engagement, linking application examples with game-development methods and expertise.
summary.zh: 从暴露、分散注意、激励、测量和参与五类过程审视临床 VR，借应用案例说明游戏开发方法与专业技能的潜在作用。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Designing a More Immersive AR Strategy Game in 'Operation Living Room'
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：在《Operation Living Room》中设计更沉浸的 AR 策略游戏

summary.en: Reviews mobile AR development across platforms, connecting world-mesh understanding, onboarding, design pillars, and technical lessons from successive strategy projects.
summary.zh: 回顾跨平台移动 AR 开发经验，围绕环境网格理解、玩家引导、设计支柱和连续策略项目中的技术取舍展开讨论。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Emergency Meeting! It's the 'Among Us VR' Postmortem
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：紧急会议！《Among Us VR》开发复盘

summary.en: Reviews the adaptation of Among Us for VR through prototyping, playtesting, production schedules, and problems encountered during pandemic-era development.
summary.zh: 复盘《Among Us》转为 VR 体验的过程，讨论原型、试玩测试、排期，以及疫情期间制作多人 VR 游戏所遇到的问题。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Innovation and Transformation: Becoming a XR Game Developer
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：创新与转型——成为 XR 游戏开发者

summary.en: Explores how traditional game-development skills transfer to emerging immersive technologies, using examples of expertise needed in nontraditional entertainment fields.
summary.zh: 通过新兴沉浸技术领域的案例，讨论传统游戏开发技能如何迁移到非传统娱乐工作，以及相关岗位需要哪些能力。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Iteration in Isolation: Finding Success as a Solo VR Developer During a Global Pandemic
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：隔离中的迭代——疫情期间的独立 VR 开发

summary.en: Reflects on SolarBlack's solo development alongside a full-time job, covering skills, publishing support, setbacks, and lessons from a two-year production.
summary.zh: 回顾在全职工作之外独立制作《SolarBlack》的两年经历，分享所需技能、发行支持、挫折及事后总结。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: Kids and XR: Leveling up While Playing It Safe
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：儿童与 XR——在安全中成长

summary.en: Discusses youth-focused XR clinical applications and behavioral interventions while examining unresolved physical, developmental, and psychological safety questions.
summary.zh: 讨论面向青少年的 XR 临床应用与行为干预，同时审视身体、发育和心理层面尚未充分研究的安全问题。

sessions.title: Future Realities Summit: The Avatar Manifesto
sessions.title_zh: 未来现实峰会：虚拟化身宣言

summary.en: Proposes shared avatar-design principles with safety and inclusion as considerations across different virtual products and metaverse experiences.
summary.zh: 提出可供不同虚拟产品采用的化身设计原则，讨论如何让安全与包容成为跨产品体验中的核心考虑。

sessions.title: Futureproof Your Game with Game Creator Services (Part 1, Panel Discussion) (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Game Creator Services 面向未来开发游戏：第一部分，圆桌讨论（微软呈现）

summary.en: A panel examines development challenges around community needs, player insights, and personalization, then discusses service approaches for ongoing player engagement.
summary.zh: 围绕社区需求、玩家洞察与个性化带来的开发复杂性，讨论持续玩家服务面临的问题及常见解决思路。

sessions.title: Futureproof your game with Game Creator Services (Part 2, AMA/Q&A) (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 用 Game Creator Services 面向未来开发游戏：第二部分，问答（微软呈现）

summary.en: Continues the service-development discussion with a recap and audience questions about engagement, community needs, insights, and increasingly personalized game operations.
summary.zh: 承接前场讨论，以回顾和现场问答的形式探讨玩家参与、社区需求、数据洞察与个性化运营相关的服务开发问题。

sessions.title: G.A.N.G. Demo Derby: Music
sessions.title_zh: G.A.N.G. 作品点评擂台：音乐

summary.en: Invites short composer submissions for critique by audio directors and professionals, with discussion of music practice for games and interactive entertainment.
summary.zh: 通过作曲者提交的短篇作品，由音频总监与行业人士进行点评，并围绕游戏及互动娱乐的音乐实践展开交流。

sessions.title: G.A.N.G. Demo Derby: Sound Design
sessions.title_zh: G.A.N.G. 作品点评擂台：声音设计

summary.en: Uses submitted sound-design excerpts as the basis for professional critique and open discussion among audio practitioners and attendees.
summary.zh: 以参与者提交的声音设计片段为基础，邀请行业专业人士点评，并与现场听众讨论具体创作实践。

sessions.title: Game Art Career Fireside with Mariel Kinuko Cartwright and Bryant Francis
sessions.title_zh: 游戏美术职业炉边谈话：Mariel Kinuko Cartwright 与 Bryant Francis

summary.en: Reflects on Cartwright's career in game art and animation, including how a focus on 2D work shaped her practice across several productions.
summary.zh: 回顾 Cartwright 从事游戏美术与动画的经历，讨论长期专注二维创作如何影响她的职业发展，并分享参与不同游戏项目的经验。

sessions.title: Game Audio Business Essentials
sessions.title_zh: 游戏音频业务基础

summary.en: A panel discusses business questions facing freelance composers and sound designers, bringing recurring game-audio community topics into a professional conversation.
summary.zh: 围绕自由作曲者与声音设计师面临的业务问题展开圆桌交流，将游戏音频社群常见的职业议题带入现场讨论。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: "Soft" Skills Are Hard! Acing the Non-Technical Interview Questions

summary.en: Career guidance examines answering interpersonal and other nontechnical interview questions.
summary.zh: 职业分享讨论如何应对人际协作等非技术面试问题。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: An Impostor's Guide to the Industry

summary.en: Developers from unconventional backgrounds discuss their routes into the game industry.
summary.zh: 来自非传统背景的开发者分享进入游戏行业的路径。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Boss Mode: Making the Most of Your Manager
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：主管模式——充分发挥管理者的作用

summary.en: Explains a manager's responsibilities and offers practical guides for taking an active role in communication and making a working relationship more useful.
summary.zh: 介绍管理者的职责与期望，并通过具体指南和模板，讨论员工如何主动沟通，让管理关系更好地支持自己的工作。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Finding Your Creative Voice Through Game Jams
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：通过 Game Jam 找到创作声音

summary.en: Discusses game jams as deliberate practice for developing professional strengths and a creative voice that can support progression toward creative leadership.
summary.zh: 把 Game Jam 视为有意识的练习，讨论如何培养专业优势与创作声音，为走向创意领导岗位积累条件。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Killer Portfolio or Portfolio Killer Part 1: Advice from Industry Artists
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：出色作品集还是求职杀手？第一部分，行业美术建议

summary.en: Art leads discuss portfolio mistakes, ways to hold a reviewer's attention, and differences in hiring practices across studios.
summary.zh: 由美术总监与主美讨论作品集的常见问题、吸引评审注意的方法，以及不同工作室招聘流程中的差异。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Micro-Postmortems: 'Casual Birder', 'ValiDate', and 'Heck Deck'
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：微型复盘——《Casual Birder》《ValiDate》与《Heck Deck》

summary.en: Three indie postmortems examine a new-console launch, an inclusive dating visual novel, and the transition from game-jam prototype to commercial release.
summary.zh: 通过三款独立游戏的短复盘，讨论新主机首发、包容性恋爱视觉小说，以及从比赛原型走向商业产品的不同挑战。

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Starting Your Career In a Post-Pandemic World

sessions.title: Game Career Seminar: Transitioning into Community Management: Transferrable Skills to Build Your Portfolio
sessions.title_zh: 游戏职业研讨：转入社区管理——用可迁移技能建立作品集

summary.zh: 介绍社区管理作品集的用途和展示方式，并讨论如何把其他岗位或经历中的可迁移技能转化为可见证据。

sessions.title: Game Design Career Fireside with Raph Koster with Bryant Francis
sessions.title_zh: 游戏设计职业炉边谈话：Raph Koster 与 Bryant Francis

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Building Rome in a Day: A Sociological Storytelling Primer

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Creating a Living World in 'Horizon Forbidden West'

summary.zh: 《地平线：西之绝境》分享让世界更具生命感的设计改进。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Devising Stories as an Ensemble

summary.zh: 本场叙事分享讨论以群体共同创作为基础，构思游戏故事的方法。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Effective Feedback for Game Writers, Narrative Designers, and Collaborators

summary.en: Narrative professionals discuss giving and receiving useful feedback across disciplines.
summary.zh: 叙事从业者分享跨专业提供、接收有效反馈的方法。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Game Narrative Review Competition Winners: Poster Analysis
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：游戏叙事评论竞赛优胜者海报分析

summary.zh: 由学生获奖者通过海报与短讲展示游戏叙事分析，研究对象涵盖大型商业作品和独立游戏。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: IP Development: Methodologies and Strategies
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：IP 开发的方法与策略

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: It's Not in the Writer's Manual: A Q&A Session for New Writers
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：写作手册之外——新作者问答

summary.zh: 通过开放问答讨论进入游戏写作行业、自由职业与雇员角色、团队协作、作者管理和报价等实际职业问题。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Learning From Loss: Designing the Experimental Narrative of 'Before Your Eyes'

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Live, Laugh, Outline: Creating Functional Outlines That Are Good

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Minimal Space, Maximum Character: Creating Characters in Small Spaces

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Pitching and Workshopping Side Quests for 'Horizon Forbidden West'

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Respecting Player Fantasies in Dating Sims
sessions.title_zh: 游戏叙事峰会：尊重恋爱模拟中的玩家幻想

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Storied Bodies: DEI Topics Through Immersive Narrative Design

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: Story: An Atomic Theory

summary.zh: 尝试把故事拆分为基本叙事要素及其相互作用，以此建立定义，并讨论这一理解对游戏设计的启发。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: The Best and Most Stealable Mechanics from Tabletop RPGs

summary.zh: 介绍桌面角色扮演中的独特机制及其对电子游戏的影响，为设计师尝试移植和改造这些思路提供切入点。

sessions.title: Game Narrative Summit: The Future of Interactive Cinema

summary.zh: 以《Recontact》为例，介绍把电影、摄影、影像艺术、音乐与文学结合到游戏中的移动互动电影叙事方法。

sessions.title: Game Production as Craft: How Producers Drive Development at Xbox Game Studios (Presented by Microsoft)

summary.zh: Xbox 制作人对比不同工作室引导游戏开发工作的方式。

sessions.title_zh: GameDeveloper.com 现场播客访谈：Charlie Cleveland

sessions.title: GameDeveloper.com Live Podcast Interview: Chris Zukowski

sessions.title: GameDeveloper.com Live Podcast Interview: Rod Humble & King Choi
sessions.title_zh: GameDeveloper.com 现场播客访谈：Rod Humble 与 King Choi

sessions.title: Games of Tomorrow - How VR developers are Mixing their Reality. (Presented by Meta)

sessions.title: GDC Main Stage: Independent Games Festival and Game Developers Choice Awards

sessions.title: Google Developer Summit: Google Play Games on PC: Multiplatform Experience Critical for Growth (Presented by Google)

sessions.title: Google Developer Summit: How to Win at Monetizing Games as a Service (Presented by Google)
