sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: How Publishing Agreements Go Wrong (and How to Fix Them)
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：发行协议如何出问题，以及如何修复

summary.en: Uses negotiation and dispute examples to explain risks in licensing, revenue share, marketing, DLC, and intellectual-property provisions.
summary.zh: 结合谈判与合作争议案例，介绍授权、收入分成、营销、DLC 和知识产权条款中的风险与应对思路。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Indie Soapbox
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：独立开发者讲坛

summary.en: Developers from varied backgrounds deliver short reflections, lessons, and provocations about independent game creation.
summary.zh: 不同背景的独立开发者以短讲形式分享创作反思、经验与值得争论的问题，呈现多样的独立开发视角。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Indie VO Toolbox Start-to-Finish: Professional, Affordable, Optimized
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：从头到尾的独立游戏配音工具箱——专业、经济与优化

summary.en: Surveys voice production from budgets and schedules through casting, direction, script preparation, editing, and collaborative recording practices.
summary.zh: 从预算与排期出发，梳理选角、导演、脚本优化、剪辑和团队协作等配音制作环节，讨论兼顾专业性与资源的做法。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Make Games Like a Horse: The Design of 'Bugsnax'
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：像马一样做游戏——《Bugsnax》的设计

summary.en: Uses Bugsnax to explore how Young Horses chooses projects, discovers their identity, and makes difficult design decisions from influences and prototypes.
summary.zh: 以《Bugsnax》为例，讨论 Young Horses 如何选择项目、寻找作品本身的方向，并在灵感与实际设计之间作出困难取舍。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Never Skip Playtest Day! Five Tips for Running Better Playtests
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：别跳过试玩日！做好试玩的五条建议

summary.en: Draws on Escape Academy's many playtests to discuss making testing central to development and organizing sessions more effectively.
summary.zh: 结合《Escape Academy》的大量试玩经验，讨论如何把测试放在开发核心位置，并更有效地组织和利用每次试玩。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: No-Budget DIY Marketing for Indie Games

summary.en: An indie-marketing session offers a lightweight framework for planning publicity with limited resources.
summary.zh: 独立游戏营销分享提供适合资源有限团队的轻量宣传规划框架。

youtube.title: No-Budget DIY Marketing for Indie Games

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Porting on a Budget: There and Back Again
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：有限预算下的移植——往返之旅

summary.en: Shares a small-team porting process, covering advance preparation, stakeholder communication, and budgeting and scheduling across multiple platforms.
summary.zh: 介绍小团队的移植流程，涵盖提前准备、各方沟通，以及多平台项目中的预算和排期安排。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: Tech Toolbox: Custom Tool Microtalks
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：技术工具箱——定制工具微型演讲

summary.en: Six studios present custom development tools and discuss reshaping workflows, asset management, and working environments beyond engine defaults.
summary.zh: 六家工作室展示定制工具，讨论如何改造工作流程、资产管理和工作环境，以适应各自项目的需要。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: The Secret Lives of NPCs: 'Wayward Strand'
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：NPC 的秘密生活——《Wayward Strand》

summary.en: Explores structuring simultaneous real-time stories around independently active NPCs and how studio care practices influenced the narrative's development.
summary.zh: 讨论如何围绕自主行动的 NPC 组织同时发生的实时故事，并介绍工作室的关怀实践如何影响叙事制作。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit: This is Why We Fight: Designing Meaningful Combat
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：这就是我们战斗的原因——设计有意义的战斗

summary.en: Examines combat through narrative and team perspectives, proposing more personal and focused encounters as avenues for meaningful design.
summary.zh: 从叙事与团队自身经验出发审视战斗，讨论更私人、更聚焦的遭遇如何成为探索意义的设计方向。

sessions.title: Independent Games Summit; Expanding the "Miniverse": Designing Deep, Minimalist Games
sessions.title_zh: 独立游戏峰会：扩展“迷你宇宙”——设计有深度的极简游戏

summary.en: Explains the Miniverse's combination of abstraction and simulation, with a mechanic-first prototyping process tested while exploring a third game.
summary.zh: 介绍“迷你宇宙”如何结合抽象形式与现实模拟，并讨论团队在探索第三款游戏时如何检验机制优先的原型方法。

sessions.title: Indie Starter Kit: The Basics of Founding a Successful Games Company
sessions.title_zh: 独立开发创业包：创办游戏公司的基础

summary.en: Walks through studio founding from initial idea to release, discussing priorities, deal structures, emotional challenges, and differences between first and later companies.
summary.zh: 从最初想法到首作发布梳理创业过程，讨论阶段重点、合作结构、情绪挑战，以及首次与后续创办公司的区别。

sessions.title: Is Beauty Emotional or Rational?: Cosmetics and Consumer Choice in 'NARAKA: BLADEPOINT'
sessions.title_zh: 美是感性还是理性？《永劫无间》的外观与消费选择

summary.en: Examines research into cosmetic preferences and purchasing patterns, asking how an abstract aesthetic judgment can be studied and quantified.
summary.zh: 围绕玩家外观偏好与购买差异，介绍《永劫无间》研究团队如何寻找消费选择规律，并尝试量化抽象的审美判断。

sessions.title: It Takes A Village: Building a Gaming and Disability Program
sessions.title_zh: 需要整个村庄：建设游戏与残障支持项目

summary.en: Explains Xbox Game Studios' accessibility organization, collaborative roles, disabled-player involvement, and resources used throughout development.
summary.zh: 介绍 Xbox Game Studios 的无障碍团队与合作角色，讨论残障玩家参与、开发阶段资源使用，以及向玩家传达无障碍信息的方法。

sessions.title: It's Better To Be Friends: Marketing "Asks" and the Reality of Game Production
sessions.title_zh: 做朋友更好：营销需求与游戏制作的现实

summary.en: Explains Finji's integrated communication and asset workflow, showing how marketing deliverables can become planned development milestones alongside production needs.
summary.zh: 介绍 Finji 统一沟通与素材制作的流程，讨论如何把营销交付纳入开发里程碑，并协调宣传需求与项目生产安排。

sessions.title: Joint-Based Skin Deformation in 'God of War Ragnarok'
sessions.title_zh: 《战神：诸神黄昏》基于关节的皮肤形变

summary.en: Explains muscle-oriented joint rigs and dynamic-bone techniques for volume preservation, soft-tissue motion, and combat impact feedback.
summary.zh: 介绍贴合肌肉结构的关节绑定与动态骨骼技术，讨论体积保持、软组织晃动及战斗冲击感的表现。

sessions.title: Kung-fu and Speed Painting: Sifu's Art Direction and World Building Approach
sessions.title_zh: 功夫与速绘：《师父》的美术方向和世界构建

summary.en: Connects martial-arts cinema, Wuxing, Confucian ideas, and digital speed painting to Sifu's visual identity, shapes, volumes, and textures.
summary.zh: 把功夫电影、五行、儒家观念与数字速绘联系起来，讨论《师父》的视觉身份以及体块、形状和纹理的塑造。

sessions.title: Launching MARVEL SNAP on Mobile with a 50-person Studio (Presented by Unity Technologies)
sessions.title_zh: 五十人工作室如何在移动端推出《MARVEL SNAP》（Unity Technologies 呈现）

summary.en: Traces Second Dinner's growth and the game's evolution, with examples of development philosophies, tools, and processes used along the way.
summary.zh: 回顾 Second Dinner 从小团队发展到推出《MARVEL SNAP》的过程，介绍游戏演变及团队采用的开发理念、工具和流程。

sessions.title: Layered Battles: Generating Multiple Qualitative Tactical Battles for 'Mario + Rabbids: Sparks of Hope'
sessions.title_zh: 分层战斗：为《马力欧＋疯狂兔子 星耀之愿》生成多样战术战斗

summary.en: Explains procedural battles assembled from arena, cover, navigation, and enemy layers, guided by tagged libraries and configuration-defined intentions.
summary.zh: 介绍由场地、掩体、导航和敌人生成四层构成的程序化战斗系统，讨论标签库与配置如何表达特定战术意图。

sessions.title: Leaders Working at the Heart of the Team in 2023
sessions.title_zh: 2023 年，领导者在团队核心工作

summary.en: Uses leadership situations to discuss trust, compassion, personal presence, and accepting mistakes when diagnosing a team's changing needs.
summary.zh: 结合领导工作中的具体情境，讨论信任、同理心、个人投入与接纳错误，思考如何判断团队不断变化的需求。

sessions.title: Leading With Empathy to Become the Best Publishing Partner in the Industry (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 以同理心带领发行合作（微软呈现）

summary.en: Discusses Xbox Game Studios Publishing's tailored approach to independent-development partnerships and how empathy and inclusion shape support for different teams.
summary.zh: 介绍 Xbox Game Studios Publishing 与独立团队合作时的定制化方法，讨论同理心与包容如何影响开发支持和伙伴关系。

sessions.title: Learn How VIP Management Can Change Your Company's Revenue Footprint
sessions.title_zh: 了解 VIP 管理如何改变公司的收入结构

summary.en: Explains data-driven VIP operations through segmentation, business cases, realistic return estimates, and adjusting services as player data reveals opportunities.
summary.zh: 介绍数据驱动的 VIP 运营，涵盖玩家细分、业务方案、现实回报估计，以及根据数据变化调整服务重点的方法。

sessions.title: Lessons Learned After Launching 25+ Web 3 Games (Presented by Wemade)
sessions.title_zh: 推出二十五款以上 Web3 游戏后的经验（Wemade 呈现）

summary.en: Shares launch data and lessons from games with distinct tokens, comparing token-economic approaches that did and did not work as intended.
summary.zh: 分享多款独立代币游戏的上线数据与经验，比较不同代币经济设计中达到预期和未达预期的做法。

sessions.title: Lessons Learned in the Trenches: Turnaround Stories Running 'Star Wars: The Old Republic,' 'Star Wars Galaxies,' and 'Ultima Online'
sessions.title_zh: 一线经验：运营《星球大战：旧共和国》《星球大战：星系》与《网络创世纪》的转折故事

summary.en: Reviews live-service leadership across three MMOs, covering management, community work, outsourcing, analytics, and lessons carried into later projects.
summary.zh: 回顾三款 MMO 的运营转折，讨论项目管理、社区、外包与数据指标，以及前一项目的经验如何影响后续工作。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: A Visual Approach to Level Design in 'Gotham Knights'
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：《哥谭骑士》的视觉化关卡设计

summary.en: Uses early missions to examine level designers' responsibility for composition, silhouette, and visual direction through successive production stages.
summary.zh: 以游戏前几项任务为例，讨论关卡设计师如何在各制作阶段主动处理构图、轮廓与视觉方向，而不把它们全部留给美术。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Benefits of Missing Out: What 'Cyberpunk 2077' Taught Us About Non-Linear Level Design
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：错过的益处——《赛博朋克2077》的非线性关卡经验

summary.en: Examines gaps between level-design intentions and player reception, then derives production-conscious techniques for making branching routes feel meaningful.
summary.zh: 分析非线性关卡的设计意图与玩家体验之间的差距，并讨论如何在兼顾制作成本的前提下让不同路线更有意义。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Designing Cauldrons for 'Horizon Forbidden West'
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：设计《地平线 西之绝境》的铸炼厂

summary.en: Traces Cauldron design from concept to completion, using IOTA and its Tallneck to examine stage-by-stage level iteration.
summary.zh: 以包含长颈兽的 IOTA 铸炼厂为重点，介绍从概念到成品的关卡设计，并展示各阶段的迭代变化。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Moving Mountains: Speedy Level Creation as a Desperate Indie Dev
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：移山之术——独立开发者的快速关卡制作

summary.en: Uses Hang Line to discuss extracting variety from one mechanic, building level synergies, and using tools to handle design and art as a solo developer.
summary.zh: 以《Hang Line》为例，讨论如何从单一核心机制发展关卡变化、组合玩法，并借助工具独立完成关卡设计与美术。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: Player as Performer: Setting the Stage for Your Audience
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：玩家即表演者——为受众搭建舞台

summary.en: Explores how designers communicate identity, choices, and stakes so players can understand and inhabit a character across linear and roleplaying games.
summary.zh: 讨论设计师如何传达角色身份、可选行动与处境利害，让玩家在不同类型游戏中理解并投入角色表演。

sessions.title: Level Design Summit: The Pandemic Production of 'Tiny Tina's Wonderlands'
sessions.title_zh: 关卡设计峰会：疫情中的《小缇娜的奇幻之地》制作

summary.en: Explains map production across mission, level-design, and art teams, including milestones, performance goals, and responses to remote-work disruptions.
summary.zh: 介绍任务、关卡设计与美术团队协作制作地图的流程，讨论里程碑、性能目标，以及突然转向远程工作等干扰的应对。

sessions.title: Level Up Your Game: Explore Play-to-Own Economy with Metamask Wallet (Presented by MetaMask and Infura)
sessions.title_zh: 升级你的游戏：用 MetaMask 钱包探索边玩边拥有经济（MetaMask 与 Infura 呈现）

summary.en: Introduces MetaMask SDK integration for token and NFT transactions, including wallet setup and purchases or trading of virtual goods in games.
summary.zh: 介绍游戏接入 MetaMask SDK 的流程，涵盖钱包设置以及利用代币和 NFT 进行虚拟物品购买、出售与交易的方式。

sessions.title: LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS Developer Summit: Exploring the Technical Arts in the Development of UNDAWN (Presented by LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS)
sessions.title_zh: 光子工作室群开发者峰会：探索《黎明觉醒》的技术美术（光子工作室群呈现）

summary.en: Discusses open-world mobile rendering and shading, including a probe-based irradiance solution for dynamic indirect lighting within device constraints.
summary.zh: 讨论移动开放世界的渲染、着色与优化，介绍基于辐照度探针处理动态间接光照的方法及设备性能约束。

sessions.title: LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS Developer Summit: HSGI: Cross-Platform Hierarchical Surfel Global Illumination (Presented by LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS)
sessions.title_zh: 光子工作室群开发者峰会：HSGI——跨平台分层 Surfel 全局光照（光子工作室群呈现）

summary.en: Explains a hierarchical surfel radiance cache reconstructed from meshes and screen data, with per-frame ray updates for dynamic cross-platform indirect lighting.
summary.zh: 介绍由网格和屏幕数据重建的分层 Surfel 辐射缓存，讨论逐帧光线更新如何支持跨平台动态间接光照。

sessions.title: LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS Developer Summit: Investigating the Utilization of Gvoice AI Codec and Haptics Technology in Mobile Gaming to Enhance Player Experience (Presented by LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS)
sessions.title_zh: 光子工作室群开发者峰会：探索 Gvoice AI 编码与触觉技术的移动游戏应用（光子工作室群呈现）

summary.en: Covers neural voice-codec models, training, quantization, packet-loss concealment, and haptic descriptions, including communication and accessibility applications.
summary.zh: 介绍神经语音编码的模型、训练、量化与丢包补偿，并讨论触觉描述方案在交流体验和无障碍信息传达中的用途。

sessions.title: LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS Developer Summit: Multi-agent AI Production of FPS Game Based on Reinforcement Learning (Presented by LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS)
sessions.title_zh: 光子工作室群开发者峰会：基于强化学习的 FPS 多智能体 AI 制作（光子工作室群呈现）

summary.en: Describes a reinforcement-learning AI approach for FPS roles such as PvE opponents, replacement teammates, and matchmaking population, contrasting its training needs with imitation learning.
summary.zh: 介绍 FPS 游戏中强化学习 AI 的应用思路，涉及 PvE 对手、掉线替补与匹配补位，并讨论其训练方式与模仿学习的差异。

sessions.title: LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS Developer Summit: PUBG MOBILE: Performance Optimization on Mobile Platform (Presented by LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS)
sessions.title_zh: 光子工作室群开发者峰会：《PUBG MOBILE》移动平台性能优化（光子工作室群呈现）

summary.en: Explains a multilevel optimization strategy for widely varying phones, examining changes to the renderer, engine, and gameplay-supporting features.
summary.zh: 介绍适应不同年代与性能手机的分层优化策略，分析渲染流水线、引擎和相关功能中的技术调整。

sessions.title: LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS Developer Summit: The Use of AI-Powered Technology in Gaming and Content Digitization (Presented by LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS)
sessions.title_zh: 光子工作室群开发者峰会：AI 技术在游戏与内容数字化中的应用（光子工作室群呈现）

summary.en: Introduces YAO's markerless sports digitization and image-based scene or object creation, discussing their technical foundations and possible use in UGC workflows.
summary.zh: 介绍 YAO 的无标记体育数字化和图像生成场景、物体的方案，讨论其技术基础及在 UGC 创作中的应用思路。

sessions.title: Living Paintings of OFK: Art Directing the Style and Lives of an Indie-Pop Band
sessions.title_zh: OFK 的活画作：独立流行乐队的风格与生活美术指导

summary.en: Revisits the team's style exploration and technical development of We Are OFK's virtual band members, drawing on different artistic backgrounds.
summary.zh: 回顾团队为《We Are OFK》虚拟乐队成员探索风格与技术的过程，讨论不同美术背景如何共同塑造角色。

sessions.title: Localization of 'Cyberpunk 2077': Technology, Tools, and Approach
sessions.title_zh: 《赛博朋克2077》的本地化：技术、工具与方法

summary.en: Explains localization organization, vendors, voice recording, and data pipelines, emphasizing cooperation between technical and localization teams and remaining shortcomings.
summary.zh: 介绍本地化团队组织、供应商、配音准备和数据流程，重点讨论技术与本地化协作，以及项目中的不足与改进方向。

sessions.title: Lost XP: Why Junior Game Developers Quit and How to Help
sessions.title_zh: 流失的经验值：初级游戏开发者为何离开，如何帮助他们

summary.en: Examines workforce research and existing interventions to discuss recruitment, training, and retention of junior and underrepresented developers.
summary.zh: 结合从业者数据与既有干预措施，讨论初级及代表性不足开发者的招聘、培训和留任问题。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: 'Wobbledoll': ML-Powered Self-Balancing Synthesis Ragdoll
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：Wobbledoll——机器学习驱动的自平衡合成布娃娃

summary.en: Explores machine learning for full-body physical interaction, considering motion quality and engineering complexity relative to conventional animation and simulation approaches.
summary.zh: 讨论用机器学习处理全身物理交互的方法，并与传统动画和模拟方案比较动作质量、适用条件及工程复杂度。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Advanced Heightmap Compression Using Deep Learning in 'Dune: Awakening'
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：《沙丘：觉醒》中基于深度学习的高级高度图压缩

summary.en: Explains deep-learning compression and decompression of large terrain heightmaps, focusing on storage demands and the visual tradeoffs of lossy data.
summary.zh: 介绍使用深度学习压缩和解压大型地形高度图的方法，讨论沙漠世界的数据存储需求与有损压缩的视觉取舍。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Differentiable Rendering for Scalable Asset Pipeline in 'Honor of Kings'
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：《王者荣耀》中用于可扩展资产流程的可微渲染

summary.en: Describes a hybrid differentiable renderer that optimizes LOD assets against image-space loss, including shading, skinning, simplification, and visibility applications.
summary.zh: 介绍结合光栅化与光追的可微渲染器，讨论如何根据图像空间误差优化 LOD，并用于着色、蒙皮、简化和可见性处理。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: GPT-3 Powered Text to Lifelike Speech and Animation for NPCs
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：用 GPT-3 将文本转为 NPC 的逼真语音与动画

summary.en: Explains an Earth Revival system combining text semantics, sentiment, speech, and speaker identity to synthesize expressive voices and full-body animation.
summary.zh: 介绍《Earth Revival》结合文本语义、情感、语音和说话者身份的系统，讨论表达性语音与全身动画的自动生成。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Natural Language Generation for Games Writing
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：用于游戏写作的自然语言生成

summary.en: Presents a writer-facing text-drafting system where narrative designers seed ideas and writers accept, revise, or regenerate suggestions for NPC dialogue.
summary.zh: 介绍面向作者的文本草稿系统，让叙事设计师提供方向，再由编剧接受、修改或重新生成 NPC 对白建议。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Parameter Selection for ASTC Mapping Compression Using Machine Learning
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：用机器学习选择 ASTC 纹理压缩参数

summary.en: Explores reinforcement-learning ideas applied to ASTC parameter selection, balancing texture compression efficiency against visual fidelity in a production setting.
summary.zh: 介绍将强化学习思路用于 ASTC 纹理压缩参数选择的方法，讨论制作环境中压缩效率与图像精度之间的权衡。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Real-Time Neural Texture Upsampling in 'God of War Ragnarok'
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：《战神：诸神黄昏》的实时神经纹理上采样

summary.en: Breaks down networks that directly produce BC-compressed blocks, PS5 GPU optimization, prototype evolution, and limitations of the adopted runtime approach.
summary.zh: 拆解直接输出 BC 压缩图像块的网络设计，讨论 PS5 GPU 优化、原型演变，以及这套运行时上采样方案的限制。

sessions.title: Machine Learning Summit: Simulating Teamfight Tactics Using Deep Learning for Fast Reinforcement Learning AI Training
sessions.title_zh: 机器学习峰会：用深度学习模拟《云顶之弈》，加快强化学习训练

summary.en: Explains a separate TFT simulator that predicts outcomes with neural networks, supporting agent training and design hypotheses without reproducing the full engine.
summary.zh: 介绍独立于游戏引擎的《云顶之弈》模拟器，讨论如何用神经网络预测结果来训练智能体，并测试设计假设。

sessions.title: Making Waves for 'Skull and Bones': Advancements in Water Tech
sessions.title_zh: 为《碧海黑帆》掀起波澜：水体技术的进展

summary.en: Traces Ubisoft Singapore's ocean and river technology, explaining simulation, rendering features, and challenges in open-world multiplayer naval experiences.
summary.zh: 回顾育碧新加坡的海洋与河流技术，介绍水体模拟和渲染，并讨论开放世界多人海战带来的特殊挑战。

sessions.title: Math in Game Development Summit: A Visual Guide to Quaternions and Dual Quaternions
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：四元数与双四元数的可视化指南

summary.en: Builds a geometric intuition for quaternion creation, interpolation, and composition, then extends it to dual-quaternion rotation and translation.
summary.zh: 从三维几何直观出发讲解四元数的构造、插值与组合，再延伸到双四元数所表达的旋转和平移。

sessions.title: Math in Game Development Summit: Heat Is Magic
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：热图的魔法

summary.en: Surveys scalar fields and spatial metadata across game disciplines, including distance and flow fields and useful operations between maps.
summary.zh: 介绍标量场与空间元数据在多个开发领域中的用途，涵盖距离场、流场，以及不同热图之间的组合与运算。

sessions.title: Math in Game Development Summit: Mobile Math: From ATan2 to Gyro Calibration
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：移动端数学——从 ATan2 到陀螺仪校准

summary.en: Explains the mathematics behind virtual controls, flick gestures, 2D interaction with 3D objects, and gyroscope or accelerometer input.
summary.zh: 介绍虚拟摇杆、方向盘、甩动手势、二维操作三维物体，以及陀螺仪和加速度计输入背后的数学实现。

sessions.title: Math in Game Development Summit: Practical Projective Geometric Algebra
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：实用射影几何代数

summary.en: Introduces geometric-algebra developments through practical manipulations relevant to game engines and other software working with three-dimensional graphics.
summary.zh: 介绍几何代数的新进展，并围绕游戏引擎和三维图形软件中常见的几何操作讨论实际用法。

sessions.title: Math in Game Development Summit: Quaternions to Homogeneous Points, Lines, and Planes
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发数学峰会：从四元数到齐次点、线、面

summary.en: Uses plane-based geometric algebra to explain intersections, transformations, distances, angles, and projections through coordinate-independent geometric operations.
summary.zh: 用基于平面的几何代数解释点、线、面的求交、变换、距离、角度和投影，讨论不依赖坐标选取的几何运算方式。

sessions.title: Matte Painting in Games
sessions.title_zh: 游戏中的数字绘景

summary.en: Explores matte-painting possibilities through varied production scenarios, explaining how teams can begin using the technique in current or future games.
summary.zh: 通过不同制作情境介绍数字绘景的可能用途，讨论团队如何理解其表现空间，并将技术引入现有或未来项目。

sessions.title: Maximizing Monetization: Strategies, Tools, and Tactics that Elevate Ad ARPDAU (Presented by InMobi)
sessions.title_zh: 最大化变现：提升广告 ARPDAU 的策略、工具与方法（InMobi 呈现）

summary.en: Examines advertising monetization through consent-information handling, drawing attention to how incomplete consent signals affect advertising requests and revenue opportunities.
summary.zh: 从用户同意信息的处理切入广告变现，讨论同意信号不完整如何影响广告请求及收入机会。

sessions.title: Mentorship Cheat Code: Raising Diverse Talent in the Games Industry
companies: Academy of Interactive Arts and Sciences (AIAS)
tags: Academy of Interactive Arts and Sciences (AIAS)
sessions.title_zh: 导师辅导秘籍：培养游戏行业的多元人才

summary.en: Industry practitioners compare mentor and mentee experiences, discussing career development and how mentoring can support underrepresented voices.
summary.zh: 由从业者分享作为导师与受辅导者的经历，讨论导师关系如何支持职业成长，并帮助代表性不足群体获得表达机会。

sessions.title: Meta's Oculus Studios: Building Next-Gen Multiplayer Games with Amazon GameLift (Presented by Amazon Web Services)
sessions.title_zh: Meta Oculus Studios：用 Amazon GameLift 构建下一代多人游戏（Amazon Web Services 呈现）

summary.en: Reviews standardizing hosting and matchmaking across Oculus studios with different engines and backend tools, focusing on their Amazon GameLift integration journey.
summary.zh: 回顾 Oculus 多家工作室在引擎与后端各异的情况下，如何借助 Amazon GameLift 统一托管和匹配服务。

sessions.title: Mitigating Harm in Design: Extremism and the Gamification of Violence
sessions.title_zh: 通过设计减轻伤害：极端主义与暴力游戏化

summary.en: Examines how community dynamics and design elements can reinforce extremist beliefs, then discusses practical design tools for mitigating indirect harms.
summary.zh: 讨论社区关系和设计元素如何被用于强化极端信念，并介绍减轻相关间接伤害的设计思路与工具。

sessions.title: Modernizing Rendering at Supercell

summary.en: Supercell describes introducing a new rendering framework and adapting existing game technology.
summary.zh: Supercell 介绍引入新渲染框架、调整现有游戏技术的过程。

sessions.title: Motion Tracking Meets AI, Creating a New Category of Games (Presented by Nex)
sessions.title_zh: 动作追踪遇见 AI，创造新的游戏类别（Nex 呈现）

summary.en: Introduces Nex's smartphone-camera motion tracking tools and discusses their use in real-time, full-body interactive game experiences.
summary.zh: 介绍 Nex 基于普通手机摄像头的动作追踪工具，讨论实时全身识别在体感互动游戏中的应用方式。

sessions.title: Moving the Needle: Microtalks on Data-Backed Design Changes
sessions.title_zh: 推动变化：数据支持设计改动的微型演讲

summary.en: Uses live-game case studies to connect diagnosed retention and social-interaction issues with design responses, UX research, and subsequent data changes.
summary.zh: 通过持续运营游戏案例，将留存、社交和多人互动问题的诊断，与设计调整、用户研究和后续数据变化联系起来。

sessions.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with 'Roller Champions'
sessions.title_zh: 《冠军冲刺》的多智能体强化学习

summary.en: Reviews training complex cooperative behaviors, collaboration with human players, and workflow changes required to integrate deep reinforcement learning into production.
summary.zh: 介绍复杂合作行为训练与人机协作问题，讨论将深度强化学习引入实际制作时的训练环境挑战和流程调整。

sessions.title: Music Design Is Composition: Interactive Music in 'Back 4 Blood'
sessions.title_zh: 音乐设计就是作曲：《喋血复仇》的互动音乐

summary.en: Explores composition and music-system design through a modular score that assembles and modulates small assets using gameplay information.
summary.zh: 围绕根据玩法信息实时拼接、叠加和调制音乐素材的模块化系统，讨论作曲与音乐设计的关系及其工作流程。

sessions.title: Narrative Moments on a Budget: Stretching Storytelling "Dollars" Across the Moments That Matter
sessions.title_zh: 有限预算的叙事时刻：把故事资源用在关键处

summary.en: Offers a framework for allocating limited narrative effort across story moments and using explicit models to guide complex production decisions.
summary.zh: 提出分配有限叙事资源的框架，讨论如何借助明确模型判断哪些时刻值得投入，并支持复杂的制作取舍。

sessions.title: New Legacies and Joining Forces in Web3 (Presented by Polygon Labs)
sessions.title_zh: Web3 中的新传承与合作（Polygon Labs 呈现）

summary.en: A panel discusses decentralized play, NFTs, virtual economies, and how web3 proposals affect development, monetization, and relationships among industry participants.
summary.zh: 围绕去中心化玩法、NFT 和虚拟经济展开圆桌，讨论 web3 设想对开发、变现以及行业参与者关系的影响。

sessions.title: New Ways to Rethink Hiring
sessions.title_zh: 重新思考招聘的新方法

summary.en: Recruiters discuss competition for talent, inclusive team building, cross-industry hiring, retention, and opportunities for the next generation of developers.
summary.zh: 招聘团队讨论人才竞争、包容团队建设、跨行业招聘和留任，并思考如何为下一代开发者创造机会。

sessions.title: Occupational Burnout in Games: Causes, Impact, and Solutions
tags: Spry Fox, a Netflix Game Studio
sessions.title_zh: 游戏行业的职业倦怠：原因、影响与应对

summary.en: Explains burnout as an environmental and systemic issue, combining personal accounts with organizational responses and practical resilience resources.
summary.zh: 把职业倦怠放在工作环境与系统因素中分析，结合个人经历讨论组织层面的应对，以及个人可使用的支持资源。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Creating Scalable, Engaging User Generated Content in 'Saints Row Boss Factory'
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：在《黑道圣徒 Boss Factory》中构建可扩展 UGC

summary.en: Explains backend support for creating, browsing, and sharing player-made characters and weapons while serving a large user population.
summary.zh: 介绍玩家自制角色和武器的创建、浏览与分享系统，讨论面对大规模用户时的后端扩展和使用体验。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Hallucinations: Baiting Cheaters Into Self-Identifying by Reversing Detection
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：幻象——反转检测，让作弊者自行暴露

summary.en: Explains fake-player bait visible to cheats but hidden from legitimate players, including implementation details and the economics of reconfigurable anti-cheat strategies.
summary.zh: 介绍只被作弊程序识别的假玩家诱饵，讨论其实现方式，以及可重新配置的“幻象”如何改变反作弊检测与规避的成本关系。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: How Online Games Get Hacked
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：线上游戏如何被攻击

summary.en: Surveys exploit history, attacker workflows, and defensive considerations, connecting technical weaknesses with game economies, purchases, and player experience.
summary.zh: 介绍线上游戏漏洞利用的历史与工作方式，讨论技术弱点对经济系统、内购和玩家体验的影响，以及开发中的防护考虑。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: How to Design an Expressive and Efficient Matchmaking System
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：如何设计表达力强且高效的匹配系统

summary.en: Explains a customizable matchmaking query language and scalable architecture that accommodates changing game rules and multiple ranking algorithms.
summary.zh: 介绍可定制的匹配查询语言与可扩展架构，讨论如何适应变化中的游戏规则，并接入不同排名算法。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Optimizing Live Gameservers with Continuous Profiling
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：用持续性能分析优化在线游戏服务器

summary.en: Demonstrates continuous profiling alongside live server fleets, using eBPF stack sampling and flame graphs to investigate where cloud CPU time goes.
summary.zh: 介绍在线服务器集群的持续性能分析，运用 eBPF 调用栈采样和火焰图定位云端 CPU 时间的实际消耗。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Predicted Physics-Based Multiplayer in 'Space Engineers'
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：《太空工程师》中基于预测的物理多人同步

summary.en: Explains hierarchical prediction with dynamic parenting and mixed static-dynamic physics for nested moving ships and characters, including implementation problems and fixes.
summary.zh: 介绍动态父子关系与混合静动态物理下的分层预测，讨论嵌套移动飞船、内部角色的同步问题及其解决思路。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: Reaching 100-Million Registrations on WinZO with Micro-Influencers Network
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：WinZO 如何借助微型影响者网络达到一亿注册

summary.en: Examines regional creator referrals and the use of data, statistical models, and machine learning to manage influencer acquisition costs and fraud.
summary.zh: 围绕本地语言创作者的推荐网络，讨论 WinZO 如何运用数据、统计模型和机器学习管理获客成本及影响者营销中的欺诈问题。

sessions.title: Online Game Technology Summit: XPR Model: Building a Truly Scalable Virtual World
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏技术峰会：XPR 模型——构建可扩展的虚拟世界

summary.en: Introduces LightSpeed's technology approach to supporting large, densely populated online worlds with many players and game elements.
summary.zh: 介绍光子团队面向大规模、高密度在线世界的技术方案，聚焦大量玩家与游戏元素共同存在时的支撑问题。

sessions.title: Open Salaries: Ensuring Equitable Pay Through Pay Transparency
sessions.title_zh: 公开薪资：通过薪酬透明促进公平报酬

summary.en: Combines research with Lightforge's experience to discuss open compensation practices, including organizational benefits, challenges, and equity considerations.
summary.zh: 结合研究与 Lightforge 的实践，讨论公开薪酬的实施方式、组织收益与挑战，以及它和职场公平之间的关系。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Agones and Quilkin: OSS Multiplayer Game Server Service Mesh on Kubernetes
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：Agones 与 Quilkin——Kubernetes 上的多人服务器服务网格

summary.en: Explains Quilkin's native Agones integration for UDP proxying, connecting Kubernetes server orchestration with communication protection and observability.
summary.zh: 介绍 Quilkin 与 Agones 的原生集成，讨论如何在 Kubernetes 游戏服务器编排中代理 UDP 流量，并加入通信保护与观测能力。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Boosting XP by Contributing to the OSS Community
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：为开源社区贡献，积累经验值

summary.en: Explains contribution agreements, intellectual-property implications, and company policies that shape how individual developers and studios participate in open source.
summary.zh: 介绍参与开源时的贡献协议、知识产权影响与公司政策，讨论个人和工作室在决定贡献内容及方式时应考虑的问题。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Evolution of Open Source 3D Physics Simulators
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：开源三维物理模拟器的演变

summary.en: Reviews major open-source physics engines, their communities and tools, and the growing relationship between simulation and learned character animation.
summary.zh: 回顾主要开源物理引擎、用户社区和制作工具，并讨论物理模拟与强化学习角色动画之间不断发展的联系。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Evolve a Legacy Game Engine With Open Source Tools
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：用开源工具演进旧游戏引擎

summary.en: Uses EVE Echoes to explain incremental adoption of Bazel and static-analysis tools while preserving normal development and contributing to upstream communities.
summary.zh: 以《EVE Echoes》为例，介绍逐步引入 Bazel 和静态分析工具的流程，讨论如何保持正常开发并回馈开源社区。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Render Graph, a Data-Oriented Approach
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：渲染图的数据导向方法

summary.en: Explains Cocos's data-driven RenderGraph, including dependency management, descriptor layouts, validation, and graph transformations for customizable pipelines.
summary.zh: 介绍 Cocos 数据驱动渲染图的设计，涵盖依赖管理、描述符布局、预先验证和图变换，以及它们如何支持自定义渲染流程。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: Simple DirectMedia Layer: Past, Present, and Future
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：SDL 的过去、现在与未来

summary.en: Combines SDL usage examples with compatibility history and major-version design decisions, covering high DPI, relative mouse input, and SDL 3 features.
summary.zh: 结合 SDL 使用案例与兼容性历史，讨论高 DPI、相对鼠标输入、主版本设计取舍及 SDL 3 的功能方向。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: The Future of Game Development Is Open Source
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：游戏开发的未来是开源的

summary.en: Discusses modularity, interoperability, and collaboration around open 3D technology as game-development expertise expands into other industries.
summary.zh: 讨论游戏技术向其他行业延伸时，开放三维技术中的模块化、互操作性与协作机制如何支持共同问题的解决。

sessions.title: Open Source Game Development Summit: The Hidden Challenges of Growth Under Self-Governance
sessions.title_zh: 开源游戏开发峰会：自治增长背后的隐性挑战

summary.en: Uses Godot to examine feature priorities, funding, promotion, contributor alignment, and inclusive community culture as an open-source project grows.
summary.zh: 以 Godot 为例，讨论开源项目扩大时的功能取舍、资金与推广、贡献者方向协调，以及尊重和包容的社区文化。

sessions.title: Open World Audio in 'Dying Light 2 Stay Human'
sessions.title_zh: 《消逝的光芒2：人与仁之战》的开放世界音频

summary.en: Explains systemic ambience and reverb distribution, automated audio placement, and sound-design inspirations within a large open-world production.
summary.zh: 介绍大规模开放世界中的氛围声与混响分布、自动音频放置，以及环境声音设计的灵感和制作约束。

sessions.title: Pain and Gain: Obtained from Applying a Reinforcement Learning Game Bot to 'BarbarQ 2'
sessions.title_zh: 强化学习机器人在《BarbarQ 2》应用中的得失

summary.en: Reviews deploying reinforcement-learning bots in 3v3v3 matches, including game-side bugs, humanlike behavior, and differences between game and AI development.
summary.zh: 复盘强化学习机器人进入三方对战玩法的过程，讨论游戏端缺陷、拟人表现，以及游戏制作与 AI 开发之间的差异。

sessions.title: Picking a Good Spot: Naughty Dog's Post System
sessions.title_zh: 选个好位置：Naughty Dog 的定位点系统

summary.en: Compares implementations of a general gameplay-position system used for NPC destinations, spawning, and attention targets, including selection and performance tradeoffs.
summary.zh: 介绍可用于 NPC 目标、物体生成和注视对象的位置系统，比较定位点的生成、选择方法与性能特点。

sessions.title: Planning for Change: How Telltale Games Developed Their Modern Writing Pipeline (Presented by Backlight Gem)
sessions.title_zh: 为变化做规划：Telltale 如何开发现代写作流程（Backlight Gem 呈现）

summary.en: Explains integrating Backlight Gem with Unreal and custom intermediaries, emphasizing evaluation, rollout planning, iteration, and production tracking in narrative tooling.
summary.zh: 介绍 Backlight Gem 与虚幻引擎及自定义中间工具的整合，讨论叙事工具评估、功能推行、迭代与制作追踪的规划。

sessions.title: Planning Marketing Beats that Increase Wishlists and Won't Disrupt Development
sessions.title_zh: 规划提升愿望单且不干扰开发的营销节点

summary.en: Uses Graffiti Games history to discuss effective wishlist campaigns, production-aware scheduling, and coordination when marketing requirements create development hurdles.
summary.zh: 结合 Graffiti Games 的历史经验，讨论愿望单营销活动、兼顾制作的排期，以及宣传需求与开发里程碑之间的协调。

sessions.title: Playing for the Planet Climate Check: 10 Steps to Climate Leadership
tags: UN Environment, Playing for the Planet
sessions.title_zh: Playing for the Planet 气候检查：气候行动的十个步骤

summary.en: Introduces Climate Check's ten actions as a way for game-industry workers to assess their current position and plan further emissions-related work.
summary.zh: 介绍 Climate Check 的十项行动，帮助游戏行业从业者梳理当前进展，并规划进一步的减排相关工作。

sessions.title: Plays Like You Remember: Adapting Classics for 'Teenage Mutant Ninja Shredder's Revenge'
sessions.title_zh: 玩起来如记忆中一样：为《忍者神龟：施莱德的复仇》改编经典

summary.en: Uses production examples to discuss identifying an older property's essential features, distinguishing recreation approaches, and introducing new design ideas.
summary.zh: 结合制作实例，讨论如何识别经典作品的关键特征、区分不同的重制做法，并在怀旧体验中加入新设计。

sessions.title: Poison Seeps: How Toxicity Erodes Trust, Degrades Player Experience, and Hurts The Bottom Line (Presented by Modulate)

sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：《LEGO Star Wars: Castaways》——构建全积木世界

summary.en: Explores tools, rendering, and procedural production decisions for building large mobile environments composed of millions of LEGO bricks.
summary.zh: 介绍小团队为移动平台构建大型全积木世界所采用的工具、渲染和制作流程，重点涉及大量积木组成的地形与背景。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: 'Mix Universe': The Tech Behind Bringing Music to the Universe
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：《Mix Universe》——把音乐带入宇宙的技术

summary.en: Explains how MetaSound, Blueprints, C++, shaders, and Niagara combine to drive a node-based musical sandbox with real-time audiovisual output.
summary.zh: 介绍如何结合 MetaSound、蓝图、C++、着色器与 Niagara，为节点式音乐沙盒生成实时音画表现。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: 3 Cities, 2 TAs, 1 Day: Techniques to Empower Artists
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：三座城市、两位技术美术、一天——赋能美术师的方法

summary.en: Presents an environment-prototyping toolkit combining efficient asset frameworks, procedural lighting, and reusable polish components for rapid large-scale level building.
summary.zh: 介绍环境原型工具包，结合高效资产框架、程序化灯光和可复用打磨模块，讨论快速搭建大规模关卡的方法。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Approaching Technical Art Techniques Unconventionally Using Unreal Engine's Niagara
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：用虚幻引擎 Niagara 探索非常规技术美术方法

summary.en: Explores Niagara as a framework for custom tools, GPU-compute experimentation, and runtime optimization of visually demanding effects.
summary.zh: 把 Niagara 作为工具开发与 GPU 计算探索框架，讨论技术美术如何用它实现非常规功能并优化运行时特效。

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Building a DCC and Project Agnostic Animation Pipeline
sessions.title_zh: 技术美术峰会：构建不依赖 DCC 与项目的动画流程

summary.en: Explains Snowdrop's extensible animation-tool framework across DCC applications, including metadata, generated interfaces, rig independence, and shared-tool challenges.
summary.zh: 介绍 Snowdrop 面向多种 DCC 软件的可扩展动画工具框架，涉及元数据、界面生成、绑定独立性及工具共享中的挑战。

sessions.title: Technical Leadership Roundtable: Soft Skills for Hard Problems (Presented by the IGDA)
sessions.title_zh: 技术领导圆桌：用软技能解决硬问题（IGDA 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses communication, trust, delegation, and alignment as practical aspects of technical leadership that help teams share load and grow.
summary.zh: 围绕沟通、信任、任务分担与目标一致展开圆桌讨论，探讨技术负责人如何支持团队承担压力并持续成长。

sessions.title: Tell Me What to Say: Active Feedback Techniques for Teams
sessions.title_zh: 告诉我该说什么：团队主动反馈技巧

summary.en: Introduces structured feedback tools that connect emotional engagement, clear communication, and psychological safety in complex game-development teams.
summary.zh: 介绍结构化反馈工具，讨论如何理解成员对项目和同事的情绪投入，并通过清晰沟通支持复杂团队的心理安全。

sessions.title: Tencent Games Developer Summit: Arena Breakout: Creating a Next-gen FPS Game on Mobile (Presented by Tencent Games)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯游戏开发者峰会：《暗区突围》——在移动端打造次世代 FPS（腾讯游戏呈现）

summary.en: Reviews research and development challenges in adapting a gritty, demanding PvP shooter experience to mobile hardware and network conditions.
summary.zh: 回顾移动平台制作硬核 PvP 射击体验的研发难题，讨论团队如何面对手机硬件与网络条件下的设计挑战。

sessions.title: Tencent Games Developer Summit: Building A Digital Great Wall with A New Game Engine (Presented by Tencent Games)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯游戏开发者峰会：用新引擎构建数字长城（腾讯游戏呈现）

summary.en: Uses Digital Great Wall to explain a modular engine's dynamic lights, GPU-driven vegetation, large-world shadows, virtual geometry, and global illumination.
summary.zh: 以数字长城项目介绍模块化引擎，涵盖动态光源、GPU 驱动植被、大世界阴影、虚拟几何与全局光照。

sessions.title: Tencent Games Developer Summit: Cloudflow Pipeline: A Catalyst for the Improvement of R&D Efficiency (Presented by Tencent Games)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯游戏开发者峰会：Cloudflow Pipeline——研发效率的催化剂（腾讯游戏呈现）

summary.en: Explains connecting tools and deliverables across requirements, content production, builds, QA, and release through a unified development pipeline.
summary.zh: 介绍统一研发流水线如何连接需求、内容制作、构建、测试与发布中的工具、交付物和数据。

sessions.title: Tencent Games Developer Summit: TiMi Audio Lab: Sound Design for Honor of Kings (Presented by Tencent Games)
sessions.title_zh: 腾讯游戏开发者峰会：天美音频实验室——《王者荣耀》的声音设计（腾讯游戏呈现）

summary.en: Uses Honor of Kings to discuss audio for ongoing multiplayer games and collaboration with musicians across different production contexts.
summary.zh: 以《王者荣耀》为例，讨论持续更新多人游戏的声音设计需求，以及音频团队与音乐人合作的制作经验。

sessions.title: Testing with Building Blocks: A Modular Approach for Quality Assurance
sessions.title_zh: 用积木测试：质量保证的模块化方法

summary.en: Explains breaking systems into testing blocks, connecting them into reusable patterns, and applying the approach to Destiny raids and dungeons.
summary.zh: 介绍把功能和系统拆成测试积木、再连接为可复用模式的方法，并结合《命运》的突袭与地牢机制说明应用。

sessions.title: The 'Lamplighters League': Music Systems and Live Recording
sessions.title_zh: 《The Lamplighters League》：音乐系统与现场录音

summary.en: Follows live music production from recording sessions to Wwise implementation, discussing workflows that apply at different project scales.
summary.zh: 从现场录音到 Wwise 实装介绍音乐制作，展示录音素材如何进入游戏，并讨论不同项目规模可采用的流程。

sessions.title: The 'TUNIC' Audio Talk
sessions.title_zh: 《TUNIC》音频分享

summary.en: Explains early audio direction, game-design influences, sound-effects methods, and implementation challenges through examples from TUNIC.
summary.zh: 介绍《TUNIC》早期音频方向的建立，讨论游戏设计如何影响声音决策，以及音效制作与技术实装中的挑战。

sessions.title: The Art Direction of 'Saints Row'
sessions.title_zh: 《黑道圣徒》的美术指导

summary.en: Explores the reboot's guiding visual rule, character and faction development, and Southwest-inspired worldbuilding through concepts and production choices.
summary.zh: 介绍重启作的核心视觉准则、角色与帮派的演变，以及如何通过概念和制作选择塑造受美国西南部启发的世界。

sessions.title: The Character Rendering Art of 'The Callisto Protocol'
sessions.title_zh: 《木卫四协议》的角色渲染艺术

summary.en: Connects controlled lighting references with face rendering across varied conditions and the integration of photorealism and art direction in a running game.
summary.zh: 把受控灯光参考与不同光照下的人脸渲染联系起来，讨论如何在实际运行的游戏中协调照片级真实感与美术方向。

sessions.title: The Cinematics of 'Horizon Forbidden West'
sessions.title_zh: 《地平线 西之绝境》的过场动画

summary.en: Breaks down selected cinematic scenes and the principles and tools used to maintain visual consistency across extensive open-world narrative content.
summary.zh: 拆解若干过场场景，介绍团队在大量开放世界叙事内容中维持视觉表现所采用的原则与工具。

sessions.title: The Current and Future Ethical Challenges in Games: XR and the Metaverse
companies: Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society at Harvard University
tags: Queen Mary University, QMUL School of Law
Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society at Harvard University
sessions.title_zh: 游戏当前与未来的伦理挑战：XR 与元宇宙

summary.en: Examines data collection, privacy, autonomy, and emerging interfaces, considering how immersive design and affective technologies may create ethical risks.
summary.zh: 围绕数据采集、隐私、自主权和新型接口展开讨论，审视沉浸设计与情感技术可能带来的伦理问题。

sessions.title: The Developers' Guide To Leveling Up Your In-Game Ad Monetization (Presented by Anzu.io)
sessions.title_zh: 开发者游戏内广告变现升级指南（Anzu.io 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses integrating intrinsic advertisements into game design and placement strategy, using publisher examples to consider revenue and gameplay experience together.
summary.zh: 结合发行商案例，讨论如何将原生游戏内广告融入场景设计与广告位策略，并同时考虑收入和游玩体验。

sessions.title: The Evolution of Game Monetization, Retention and Acquisition (Presented by Amazon Prime Gaming, Voodoo, Nifty Games, Publicis Groupe and SCUTI / Lenderwize)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏变现、留存与获客的演变（多方联合呈现）

summary.en: A panel revisits acquisition, retention, cash flow, and monetization approaches, with discussion of rewarded hybrid models already used in the market.
summary.zh: 圆桌重新审视获客、留存、现金流与变现方法，讨论市场中已采用的奖励型混合商业模式及其适用思路。

sessions.title: The Facial Animation Pipeline of 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II' (Presented by DI4D)
sessions.title_zh: 《使命召唤：现代战争II》的面部动画流程（DI4D 呈现）

summary.en: Details facial scanning, learned rig parameters, and performance transfer using expression data and head-mounted cameras for digital doubles.
summary.zh: 介绍数字替身的面部扫描、参数化绑定学习与表演转移流程，讨论表情数据和头戴摄像机采集如何进入制作链条。

sessions.title: The Final Battle of 'God of War Ragnarok': Techniques for Delivering High-Stakes Sequences
sessions.title_zh: 《战神：诸神黄昏》的最终决战：交付高风险场景的技术

summary.en: Reviews the climactic battle's production through combat pacing, art optimization, team structure, and data organization under demanding end-game constraints.
summary.zh: 复盘最终决战的制作，讨论在结尾关卡的时间和规模压力下，如何处理战斗节奏、美术优化、团队结构与数据组织。

sessions.title: The Future of AI in Gaming (Presented by King)
sessions.title_zh: 游戏 AI 的未来（King 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses King's AI work and longer-term plans alongside broader questions of design impact, integration, technical challenges, and industry preparation.
summary.zh: 介绍 King 的 AI 工作与长期规划，并讨论 AI 对设计的影响、既有游戏集成、技术挑战和行业准备。

sessions.title: The Future of Game Communities, and How We Avoid It
sessions.title_zh: 游戏社区的未来，以及我们如何避免它

summary.en: Traces changes in community models across retail, major releases, streaming, and NFT projects, highlighting warning signs through community-management theory.
summary.zh: 回顾零售、大型游戏、直播和 NFT 项目中的社区模式变化，运用社区管理视角识别其中值得警惕的发展趋势。

sessions.title: The Golden Rule of Game Promotion: No One Cares About Your Game

summary.en: A marketing session examines focusing promotion around the audience rather than assumed interest in a game.
summary.zh: 营销分享讨论如何围绕受众规划推广，而非预设别人会关注游戏。

youtube.title: The Golden Rule of Game Promotion: No One Cares About Your Game

sessions.title: The Happy, Engaged Game Developer Game
sessions.title_zh: 快乐而投入的游戏开发者游戏

summary.en: Uses interactive everyday work choices to compare personal habits with research on concentration, happiness, engagement, and motivation.
summary.zh: 通过日常工作选择的互动练习，把个人习惯与关于专注、快乐、投入和动机的研究相对照。

sessions.title: The History of Latinx Characters in Games
sessions.title_zh: 游戏中拉丁裔角色的历史

summary.en: Reviews Latino character representation, examining stronger and weaker examples and developers' role in creating authentic characters and stories.
summary.zh: 回顾游戏中拉丁裔角色的呈现历史，分析不同案例的得失，并讨论开发者在塑造真实角色与故事中的责任。

sessions.title: The Importance of Responsible AI in the Game Industry (Presented by Microsoft)
sessions.title_zh: 负责任的 AI 在游戏行业中的重要性（微软呈现）

summary.en: Discusses AI's established and emerging development roles alongside Microsoft's responsible-AI framework and considerations for players, workers, and production processes.
summary.zh: 讨论 AI 在游戏开发中的既有与新兴用途，并结合微软的负责任 AI 框架，考虑其对玩家、从业者和生产流程的影响。

sessions.title: The Language of Gameplay and How to Speak It
sessions.title_zh: 玩法的语言，以及如何表达它

summary.en: Explores how player actions and systems communicate meaning, proposing conceptual tools for intentionally shaping the story of the whole play experience.
summary.zh: 讨论玩家行动与系统如何传递意义，并提出有意识地设计整体游玩体验、通过玩法表达主题的概念工具。

sessions.title: The Language of Leveling Up: Crafting Your Unapologetic Career Stories
sessions.title_zh: 升级的语言：自信讲述你的职业故事

summary.en: Introduces career gap analysis, professional language for applications, and negotiation frameworks linked to personal values and hiring expectations.
summary.zh: 介绍职业需求差距分析、求职材料中的专业表达与谈判框架，讨论如何结合个人价值和招聘预期讲述职业经验。

sessions.title: The Level Design Evolution of 'A Plague Tale'
sessions.title_zh: 《瘟疫传说》的关卡设计演变

summary.en: Uses action and narrative-level examples to discuss expanding player opportunities within a story-led game and lessons from developing the sequel.
summary.zh: 通过动作关卡与叙事区域案例，讨论故事驱动游戏如何拓展玩家机会，并分享续作关卡制作中的挑战与经验。

sessions.title: The Making of 'Zoo Tycoon'
sessions.title_zh: 《动物园大亨》的制作

summary.en: Recounts Blue Fang's founding and financing, the origins of Zoo Tycoon's gameplay, publisher pitches, and the project's development into a franchise.
summary.zh: 回顾 Blue Fang 的创办与融资、《动物园大亨》玩法的起源、发行推介，以及项目逐渐成形的制作过程。

sessions.title: The Many Dimensions of Kirby

summary.en: Kirby's developers discuss bringing established series gameplay into a three-dimensional world.
summary.zh: 《星之卡比》开发者分享将系列传统玩法带入三维世界的过程。

sessions.title: The Most Important Question in Game Development
sessions.title_zh: 游戏开发中最重要的问题

summary.en: Discusses a shared question as a tool for clarifying competing goals, reducing meeting friction, and helping multidisciplinary teams iterate.
summary.zh: 介绍用共同问题澄清冲突目标的方法，讨论如何减少会议中的混乱，并帮助多专业团队朝可执行的迭代方向前进。

sessions.title: The Multi-Platform Gamer: Understanding the Complexity of Today's Gaming Habits
sessions.title_zh: 多平台玩家：理解当代游玩习惯的复杂性

summary.en: Uses consumer research to examine overlapping play across devices and genres, questioning simple platform-based audience categories used in planning and marketing.
summary.zh: 运用消费者研究分析跨设备、跨品类的游玩重叠，讨论按平台简单划分受众时可能忽略的行为与需求。

sessions.title: The Next Generation of Blockchain Gaming. Where Fun Meets Functional. (Presented by SKALE Labs)
sessions.title_zh: 下一代区块链游戏：让乐趣与功能相遇（SKALE Labs 呈现）

summary.en: A panel discusses blockchain-game user experience, compliance, utility NFTs, asset ownership, DAOs, and player-run economies as possible design directions.
summary.zh: 围绕区块链游戏的用户体验、合规、功能型 NFT、资产所有权、DAO 与玩家经济展开讨论，审视相关设计方向与挑战。

sessions.title: The Production Secrets of 'Return to Monkey Island'
sessions.title_zh: 《重返猴岛》的制作秘诀

summary.en: Shares remote production practices through task databases, early playability, iterative development, cutscene pipelines, meetings, and team-building examples.
summary.zh: 通过任务数据库、早期可玩版本、迭代、过场流程、会议与团队活动案例，分享全远程制作《重返猴岛》的方法。

sessions.title: The Professional Closet: On Being "Out" in the Game Industry
sessions.title_zh: 职场衣柜：在游戏行业公开身份

summary.en: Combines personal and shared experiences of professional coming out with practical discussion of workplaces that support LGBTQIA+ employees' openness.
summary.zh: 结合个人与他人的职场出柜经历，讨论怎样的环境能够支持 LGBTQIA+ 员工公开身份并完整地参与工作。

sessions.title: The Science of Managing Transitions During Crisis
sessions.title_zh: 危机期间管理转变的科学

summary.en: Explores phases of personal transition, the tensions of optimism during crisis, and tools for supporting people through organizational change.
summary.zh: 介绍个人适应变化的阶段、危机中乐观态度的取舍，以及带领自己和他人应对组织变化的实用工具。

sessions.title: The State of the Games Industry
sessions.title_zh: 游戏行业现状

summary.en: Uses Newzoo market research to review industry scale and discuss consolidation, cloud play, XR, web3, and metaverse trends from a 2023 perspective.
summary.zh: 运用 Newzoo 市场研究回顾行业规模，并从 2023 年的视角讨论整合、云游戏、XR、web3 与元宇宙等趋势。

sessions.title: The State of Web3 Gaming and its Impact on the Gaming World (Presented by ChainSafe)
sessions.title_zh: Web3 游戏现状及其对游戏世界的影响（ChainSafe 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses how traditional studios might approach web3, considering digital-asset trading, collaborative creation, accessibility, and the sector's possible future.
summary.zh: 讨论传统工作室进入 web3 的可能方式，涉及数字资产交易、协作创作、可接近性及这一领域未来发展的设想。

sessions.title: The Top 5 Tips for Managing Toxicity and Building a More Positive Community (Presented by Modulate)
sessions.title_zh: 管理不良行为、建设积极社区的五条建议（Modulate 呈现）

summary.en: Explores responses to toxic players, community conduct rules, and enforcement practices that consider the wider player community.
summary.zh: 围绕不良玩家处理、行为准则和执行方式分享建议，讨论如何在采取管理行动时兼顾其他玩家的社区体验。

sessions.title: The Trap of Marketing "Authentic" Games: Lessons from South-East Asia
sessions.title_zh: 营销“真实”游戏的陷阱：来自东南亚的经验

summary.en: Examines Southeast Asian development and publishing experiences to discuss cultural expression, market expectations, practical barriers, and regional ecosystem growth.
summary.zh: 结合东南亚开发与发行经验，讨论文化表达和市场期待之间的距离，以及实际障碍和地区生态发展的可能路径。

sessions.title: Thirty Years Later: Scoring 'Return to Monkey Island'
sessions.title_zh: 三十年后：为《重返猴岛》配乐

summary.en: Explores collaboration among returning composers, blending musical styles and old and new themes, and designing adaptive structures with FMOD.
summary.zh: 介绍回归作曲团队如何融合不同风格、旧主题与新主题，并讨论用 FMOD 设计自适应音乐结构的过程。

sessions.title: Thousands of Soldiers Battle on One Mobile Screen: Applications of Unity's DOTS in 'Return to Empire'
sessions.title_zh: 手机同屏千军作战：Unity DOTS 在《重返帝国》中的应用

summary.en: Explains DOTS-based data abstraction, parallel tasks, logic decomposition, rendering, and asset workflows for large mobile strategy battles.
summary.zh: 介绍 DOTS 在大规模移动策略战斗中的数据抽象、任务并行和逻辑拆分，并讨论渲染优化与美术资产流程。

sessions.title: Three Musketeers of Narrative Design in 'Cyberpunk 2077'
sessions.title_zh: 《赛博朋克2077》叙事设计的三位火枪手

summary.en: Examines splitting narrative design into three roles and using shared tools to support simultaneous collaboration in a real-time first-person game.
summary.zh: 讨论将叙事设计拆成三个角色的利弊，以及如何通过共同工具支持实时第一人称游戏中的同步跨部门协作。

sessions.title: To the Beat Y'all: What Designers Can Learn From Hip Hop
sessions.title_zh: 跟着节拍：设计师能从嘻哈中学到什么

summary.en: Connects emcee literary techniques with game dialogue and story structure, using musical and game examples to explore concise and layered language.
summary.zh: 把说唱歌手的文学技巧与游戏对白、故事结构联系起来，通过音乐和游戏案例讨论语言的精简、术语与层次。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Cosmonious High Case Study of Seret: Building a Custom VO System
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：《Cosmonious High》Seret 案例——构建定制配音系统

summary.en: Explains designing an internal narrative-audio pipeline for dialogue scale, iteration, and automation, including production challenges that expanded the tool.
summary.zh: 介绍内部叙事音频系统 Seret 的设计，讨论对话规模、迭代和自动化需求，以及制作问题如何推动工具功能扩展。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: How 'Fortnite' Designers Made Their Own Tools
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：《堡垒之夜》设计师如何制作自己的工具

summary.en: Explains Blueprint-driven Editor Utility Widgets that let quest designers build and refine specialized asset-editing tools for their own workflows.

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Managing Source Content for 'Overwatch 2'

sessions.title: Tools Summit: SpeechEditor: A Versatile Tool to Edit Speech with Low Resources
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：SpeechEditor——低资源语音编辑工具

sessions.title: Tools Summit: TestMonkey: Automated Testing at Santa Monica Studio
sessions.title_zh: 工具峰会：TestMonkey——Santa Monica 的自动化测试

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Tools to Build a World in One Day

sessions.title: Transformation 101: Launching Your Own Blockchain Game on WEMIX PLAY (Presented by Wemade)

sessions.title: Unity Developer Summit: Cross-Platform Game Development with the New URP Sample Scene (Presented by Unity Technologies)

sessions.title: Unity Developer Summit: Multiplatform Performance: Overcoming Technical Challenges (Presented by Unity Technologies)

sessions.title: Unity Developer Summit: Technical Tips for Every Stage of Game Creation (Presented by Unity Technologies)

sessions.title: Unity Developer Summit: The Big Unity AMA, 2023 Edition (Presented by Unity Technologies)

summary.en: Examines legitimate in-game-item trading and alternatives to speculative collectible models, connecting marketplace design with player experience and ongoing revenue.
summary.zh: 讨论游戏物品合法交易与投机收藏模式之外的做法，分析市场设计如何关联玩家体验及持续收入。

sessions.title: Web3 Forum: How Treasure Brought 100,000 Gamers to Arbitrum, Ethereum's Largest Scaling Solution (Presented by Offchain Labs)
sessions.title_zh: Web3 论坛：Treasure 如何把玩家带到 Arbitrum（Offchain Labs 呈现）

summary.en: Uses Treasure to discuss building a community-led gaming ecosystem on Arbitrum, linking games, creators, resources, and shared infrastructure.
summary.zh: 以 Treasure 为例，讨论在 Arbitrum 上建设社区驱动游戏生态的方法，涉及游戏、创作者、资源与基础设施的连接。

sessions.title: Web3 Forum: MARBLEX: Metaverse Ecosystem for Gamers (Netmarble - Meta World: My City) (Presented by Netmarble - MARBLEX)
sessions.title_zh: Web3 论坛：MARBLEX 玩家元宇宙生态与《Meta World: My City》（Netmarble MARBLEX 呈现）

summary.en: Reviews MARBLEX's 2022 services and games, then outlines its 2023 ecosystem direction and plans surrounding Meta World: My City.
summary.zh: 回顾 MARBLEX 在 2022 年推出的服务与游戏，介绍 2023 年生态建设方向及《Meta World: My City》的相关规划。

sessions.title: Web3 Forum: Real BUIDL: Ultimate Scaling Solution for Web3 Gaming (Presented by NodeReal)
sessions.title_zh: Web3 论坛：Real BUIDL——Web3 游戏扩展方案（NodeReal 呈现）

summary.en: A panel examines adoption barriers through crypto education, traditional publisher economics, blockchain tooling, and simpler login for non-crypto players.
summary.zh: 圆桌从加密知识教育、传统发行收入模式、区块链工具和简化登录等角度，讨论非加密玩家进入 Web3 游戏的障碍。

sessions.title: Web3 Forum: The Future of Gaming: Exclusive Updates, Breakout Games and Partnerships (Presented by Immutable)
sessions.title_zh: Web3 论坛：游戏的未来——独家进展、潜力游戏与合作（Immutable 呈现）

summary.en: Traces Etherbots and Gods Unchained into Immutable's platform approach, discussing transaction costs, scaling limits, asset ownership, and user-experience goals.
summary.zh: 从《Etherbots》和《Gods Unchained》回顾 Immutable 平台思路的形成，讨论交易成本、扩展限制、资产所有权与用户体验目标。

sessions.title: Wemade Developer Summit: The Future of Gaming: Inter-game Play and Beyond (Presented by Wemade)
sessions.title_zh: Wemade 开发者峰会：游戏的未来——跨游戏游玩及更多可能（Wemade 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses interconnected game economies built around tokens and NFTs, asking how cross-game asset use could change future game ecosystems.
summary.zh: 讨论围绕代币和 NFT 连接游戏经济的设想，思考跨游戏资产使用可能如何影响未来的游戏生态。

sessions.title: What the F-UX is UX?
sessions.title_zh: UX 到底是什么？

summary.en: Explores inconsistent UX job descriptions and ways to infer employer needs, frame relevant experience, and tailor a resume to suitable roles.
summary.zh: 分析 UX 职位描述中的不一致，讨论如何理解雇主真正需要的能力、整理相关经历，并为合适岗位调整求职材料。

sessions.title: What's Up with VR? Meta Quest Today and Where It's Going Tomorrow (Presented by Meta)
sessions.title_zh: VR 近况如何？Meta Quest 的今天与明天（Meta 呈现）

summary.en: Surveys the Quest game market, changing software expectations, business milestones, and emerging opportunities in mixed reality and future hardware.
summary.zh: 概述 Quest 游戏市场、不断变化的软件预期与业务节点，并讨论混合现实及未来技术带来的新机会。

sessions.title: Why 200+ Games Choose ProudNet for their Game Server (Presented by PlayDapp)
sessions.title_zh: 为什么两百多款游戏选择 ProudNet 服务器引擎（PlayDapp 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses game-server development through speed, security, cost, and flexibility, explaining the case for network middleware and drawing on game-production examples.
summary.zh: 围绕速度、安全、成本与灵活性讨论游戏服务器开发，并结合项目案例介绍采用网络中间件的考虑。

sessions.title: Why a Game of Any Size Can Benefit From Denuvo's Anti-cheat Solutions
sessions.title_zh: 为何不同规模游戏都可关注 Denuvo 反作弊方案

summary.en: An Irdeto-sponsored Game Developer news-desk interview addresses anti-cheat solutions in the context of games of different sizes.
summary.zh: 这场由 Irdeto 呈现的 Game Developer 新闻访谈，围绕不同规模游戏与反作弊方案的关系展开交流。

sessions.title: Workflow Improvement Methods for Frostbite
sessions.title_zh: Frostbite 工作流程的改进方法

summary.en: Explains user-feedback loops and engineering changes that balance major features with small usability requests and simplify issue reporting and tracking.
summary.zh: 介绍用户反馈循环与工程改进，讨论如何平衡大型功能和日常易用性需求，并简化问题提交与追踪流程。

sessions.title: Xsolla Developer Summit: Emerging Approaches: What the Metaverse Can Teach us About Social and Narrative Design Through Synthetic Media (Presented by X.LA)
sessions.title_zh: Xsolla 开发者峰会：新兴方法——合成媒体与元宇宙对社交和叙事设计的启示（X.LA 呈现）

summary.en: Explores connected personal spaces, identity across worlds, and AI-generated content as responses to personalization needs and the scale of virtual-world production.
summary.zh: 讨论互联个人空间、跨世界身份与个性化体验，并思考 AI 生成内容如何回应虚拟世界制作规模和内容需求。

sessions.title: Xsolla Developer Summit: Enjoy the Game: Industry Statistics and Trends 2023 (Presented by Xsolla)
sessions.title_zh: Xsolla 开发者峰会：享受游戏——2023 行业数据与趋势（Xsolla 呈现）

summary.en: Uses market data and partner perspectives to discuss emerging regions, consolidation, AI's workforce effects, UGC, NFTs, and metaverse expectations.
summary.zh: 结合市场数据与合作伙伴视角，讨论新兴地区、行业整合、AI 对工作岗位的影响，以及 UGC、NFT 和元宇宙趋势。

sessions.title: Xsolla Developer Summit: Giving Gamers More Rewarding Ways to P(l)ay (Presented by Xsolla)
sessions.title_zh: Xsolla 开发者峰会：让玩家获得更有回报的支付体验（Xsolla 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses payment difficulties in games and how emerging transaction technologies and loyalty programs might respond to security, convenience, and reward needs.
summary.zh: 讨论游戏支付中的困难，以及新支付技术与忠诚度方案如何回应安全、便利和奖励方面的需求。

sessions.title: Xsolla Developer Summit: The Anatomy of a Slow Video Game Hit (Presented by Xsolla)
sessions.title_zh: Xsolla 开发者峰会：剖析一款慢热游戏（Xsolla 呈现）

summary.en: A conversation between Justin Berenbaum and Yuval Markovich follows the practical path from game ideation through funding and launch.
summary.zh: 通过 Justin Berenbaum 与 Yuval Markovich 的对谈，梳理从游戏构思、获得资金到发布的实际开发与融资问题。

sessions.title: Xsolla Developer Summit: What are We Expecting From 2023? (Presented by Xsolla)
sessions.title_zh: Xsolla 开发者峰会：我们对 2023 年有何期待？（Xsolla 呈现）

summary.en: Industry leaders reflect on lessons from the preceding year and share expectations for the game industry's development in 2023.
summary.zh: 由行业人士回顾前一年的经验与事后认识，并分享对 2023 年游戏行业发展的期待。

sessions.title: Xsolla Developer Summit: Why Not Go Direct to Your Consumers? (Presented by Xsolla)
sessions.title_zh: Xsolla 开发者峰会：为什么不直接面向消费者？（Xsolla 呈现）

summary.en: Discusses direct player relationships through purchase journeys, community building, cross-promotion, payment choices, and experiences from differently sized studios.
summary.zh: 围绕购买流程、社区、交叉推广和支付选择，讨论开发者直接连接玩家的方式，并比较不同规模团队的经验。

sessions.title: You're Probably Wrong About the VR Games Market
sessions.title_zh: 你可能误判了 VR 游戏市场

summary.en: Uses nDreams' experience and industry data to argue for reassessing VR's market scale and the opportunities perceived by an established VR developer.
summary.zh: 结合 nDreams 的经历与行业数据，提出重新评估 VR 市场规模的观点，并讨论资深 VR 团队看到的开发机会。

sessions.title: Your Architecture Designs You: How Architectural Principles Impact Gameplay and Experience
sessions.title_zh: 建筑也在设计你：建筑原则如何影响玩法与体验

summary.en: Connects architectural surveying and mapping with game-world analysis, discussing how shared design principles can inform digital environment creation.
summary.zh: 把建筑测绘与游戏世界分析联系起来，讨论现实建成环境的规律和共有设计原则如何启发数字环境制作。

sessions.title: Your DEI Initiatives Are Making Your Culture Worse
sessions.title_zh: 你的多元、平等与包容举措为何让文化变差

summary.en: Critiques institutional obstacles to inclusion through developer-workplace examples and discusses worker empowerment as a basis for sustained cultural change.
summary.zh: 结合开发者工作环境案例，分析包容举措中的制度障碍，并讨论如何以员工赋权为基础推动持续的文化改变。
